items.title: Senators rally from early 2-goal deficit, beat Predators in shootout
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Shane Pinto beat Matt Murray in the third round of the shootout as the Ottawa Senators rallied for a 3-2 win over the visiting Nashville Predators on Saturday.
items.body:
Shane Pinto beat Matt Murray in the third round of the shootout as the Ottawa Senators rallied for a 3-2 win over the visiting Nashville Predators on Saturday.
Tim Stutzle had a goal and an assist in regulation and scored in the second round of the shootout. Drake Batherson also scored for the Senators, while Ottawa goaltender Linus Ullmark stopped 16 shots.
Ross Colton and Jonathan Marchessault scored first-period goals, and Ryan O'Reilly had a shootout goal for Nashville.
Murray recorded 18 saves in his first start since the 2023-24 season, when he played for the Dallas Stars.
Ullmark saved Steven Stamkos' final shootout attempt to secure the win.
Earlier in the third, with an extra attacker on the ice, Stutzle's shot deflected off Pinto and ricocheted off Batherson's shin to tie the game at 2-2 at 18:37.
The Predators struck first at 8:50 of the opening period when a loose puck emerged from a crowd near the left circle. Colton collected it and snapped a quick shot past Ullmark into the top-right corner of the net.
Marchessault doubled Nashville's lead on the power play at 13:10. Taking a pass from Stamkos just below the left circle, Marchessault turned and fired, slipping a shot between Ullmark's stick and the post to make it 2-0.
Ottawa cut its deficit to 2-1 on a power-play goal at 9:29 of the second period. Dylan Cozens slid a cross-ice pass to Stutzle, who rifled a one-timer into the net.
Murray gloved Cozens' shot at 13:40 of the second period. Moments later, Thomas Chabot's wrist shot through traffic rang off the left post.
Later in the second period, the Predators killed off Ottawa's 5-on-3 advantage.
The Predators killed off a power play to open overtime, and as Roman Josi emerged from the penalty box, he collected a rebound at center ice and skated in alone on Ullmark, who turned aside his shot.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rickard Rakell lifts Penguins over Stars with shootout winner
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Rickard Rakell scored the shootout winner in the fourth round and the Penguins beat the Dallas Stars 2-1 Saturday night in Pittsburgh.
items.body:
Rickard Rakell scored the shootout winner in the fourth round and the Penguins beat the Dallas Stars 2-1 Saturday night in Pittsburgh.
Dallas forced overtime when Tyler Seguin tied it 1-1 with 30 seconds left in regulation after Roope Hintz won a faceoff and Seguin deflected Jason Robertson's shot past Arturs Silovs.
Ben Kindel and Sidney Crosby also tallied in the shootout for the Penguins while Seguin and Wyatt Johnston scored for Dallas. After Rakell's goal put Pittsburgh up, Silovs deflected Mikko Rantanen's shot to end it.
Connor Dewar scored his first goal of the season for the Penguins, who were playing the second of a back-to-back and had lost three straight (0-2-1). Silovs made 24 saves.
Jake Oettinger made 19 saves for Dallas, which had won two straight.
Oettinger, who came in with consecutive shutouts, saw his shutout streak end at 188:52, the third longest in franchise history.
Crosby is still looking for his first regulation goal six games into the season.
Pittsburgh was 0-for-5 on the power play; Dallas was 0-for-3.
The Penguins appeared to take a 1-0 lead late in the first period when Stars forward Justin Hryckowian tapped a loose puck into his own net during a scramble in front. But it was ruled that Pittsburgh's Hendrix Lapierre used a high stick earlier in the sequence.
Silovs robbed Seguin with his left pad with 4:25 remaining in the second period to keep the game scoreless.
Oettinger made a superb glove save against Crosby in the slot in the opening minute of the third period.
Dewar made It 1-0 at 1:57 of the third period. He carried the puck into the zone along the left boards, cut across the slot and lifted a backhand that deflected off Dallas defenseman Lian Bichsel's stick and over Oettinger's right shoulder.
Oettinger made a pair of saves on Evgeni Malkin in the final minute of overtime.
--Field Level Media

items.title: サッカー＝バルセロナ快勝で開幕からの連勝キープ、レアルは辛勝
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マドリード　１０日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［マドリード　１０日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのスペイン１部は１０日、各地で試合を行い、昨季王者で首位のバルセロナがヘタフェを３─０で下し、開幕から８連勝とした。

バルセロナは前半２分、アンソニー・ゴードンの放ったシュートが相手選手に当たってコースが変わり、ネットを揺らして先制に成功。同３０分にはこの日が新天地での初先発となったガブリエル・ジェズスが加点し、最後はジュール・クンデのゴールで締めくくった。

レアル・マドリードはビリャレアルに１─０で辛勝。後半１７分に１９歳のヤン・ディオマンデがオフサイドトラップをかいくぐって挙げたゴールが決勝点となった。今夏に加入した同選手にとって、これがレアルでの初ゴール。

レアルはその８分後、ビニシウス・ジュニオールがネットを揺らすも、ビデオ・アシスタント・レフェリー（ＶＡＲ）の介入により、ゴール前に相手選手の髪を引っ張っていたとしてノーゴール判定に。さらにジュニオールは一発退場となった。

その他、アトレチコ・マドリードはアラベスに２─１で勝利。ラヨ・バリェカノ─ビルバオの一戦は、スタジアムでラヨのファンがクラブオーナーへの抗議としてピッチに物を投げ込むなどし、１５分間の中断の後に中止となった。

items.title: 米司法省、独禁法違反の疑いでテレビ5社調査　ホワイトハウス取材停止巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] - 米司法省は３日、ＡＢＣ、ＣＢＳ、ＣＮＮ、ＮＢＣ、ＦＯＸのテレビ局５社を反トラスト法（独占禁止法）違反の疑いで調査していると明らかにした。ＣＮＮなど３社の記者証を取り消したホワイトハウスに抗議し、各局が代表取材をボイコットしたことを受けた措置。

司法省の報道官は「ライバル企業同士が集団でボイコットすることは、シャーマン法に違反する可能性がある」と指摘。「反トラスト局は、これらの報道機関が反トラスト法に違反したかどうかを判断するため調査しているにすぎない」と述べた。

トランプ政権と主要報道機関の対立が相次ぐ中、今回の調査は新たな火種となる。トランプ大統領は主要メディアを繰り返し「フェイクニュース」と呼び、記者とのやり取りで衝突することも多い。

各社からコメントは得られていない。

ホワイトハウスは９月１９日、ＣＮＮ、ポリティコ、ＭＳ

トランプ政権と主要報道機関の対立が相次ぐ中、今回の調査は新たな火種となる。トランプ大統領は主要メディアを繰り返し「フェイクニュース」と呼び、記者とのやり取りで衝突することも多い。

各社からコメントは得られていない。

ホワイトハウスは９月１９日、ＣＮＮ、ポリティコ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷの記者証を取り消し、記者のホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを禁止した。ホワイトハウスは、大統領を取材することは「権利ではなく特権だ」と主張した。

これに対し３社は、取材排除は憲法修正第１条に違反し、報道内容への報復措置だとして政権を提訴。ホワイトハウスを取材する主要テレビ５社は連帯して取材を停止した。

items.title: Canadian ransomware negotiator arrested amid FBI hacker crackdown
items.author: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.summary: A Canadian ransomware negotiator was arrested Thursday and faces unspecified extortion charges, according to court documents, prison records and a person familiar with the matter, as the FBI cracks down on a hacking group that stole information about its employees.
items.body:
A Canadian ransomware negotiator was arrested Thursday and faces unspecified extortion charges, according to court documents, prison records and a person familiar with the matter, as the FBI cracks down on a hacking group that stole information about its employees.
Edward Dubrovsky faces charges of conspiracy to "threaten to impair the confidentiality of information with intent to extort money" and "interference with commerce," according to court documents filed with the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, which covers Philadelphia.
The records, which are partially sealed, provide conflicting spellings of his last name — "Dobrovsky" or "Dobrosky" — and do not identify his age, profession, or employer. A person briefed on the matter said the person was Canadian cybersecurity executive Edward Dubrovsky.
Federal prosecutors in Philadelphia did not return repeated messages seeking comment about the discrepancies. Attempts to reach Dubrovsky and his attorneys were unsuccessful. Repeated attempts to reach the company displayed on Dubrovsky's LinkedIn profile, CyberSteward, were similarly unsuccessful.
CyberSteward advertises itself online as specializing in "threat actor engagement, cyber-extortions, complex negotiations, and settlement facilitation." On LinkedIn, Dubrovsky presents himself as a specialist in the process of negotiating with cybercriminals over ransom payments.
Electronic wallet records leaked in 2010 and preserved by dark-web intelligence firm District 4 Labs identify Dubrovsky as a resident of Richmond Hill, north of Toronto, and put his current age at 54. Federal prison records show that a 54-year-old named Edward Dubrovsky is currently being detained at a federal detention center in Philadelphia.
News of Dubrovsky's arrest was earlier reported by Politico and independent journalist Brian Krebs .
The arrest comes as the Federal Bureau of Investigation is leading a global crackdown on the hacking group ShinyHunters, which rattled the bureau last month by stealing information on what it said was [USN:L6N45E0VU TEXT:"nearly every FBI employee"].
When Reuters asked the FBI about Dubrovsky's arrest, it referred the news agency to FBI Director Kash Patel's [USN:L6N45V0R8 TEXT:"statement on Friday"] revealing that the bureau had arrested a "suspected co-conspirator of the ShinyHunters group" and declined further comment.

items.title: William Nylander (5 points) propels Maple Leafs past Avalanche
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: William Nylander had two goals and three assists, Auston Matthews had two goals and two assists, and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 in Denver on Saturday night.
items.body:
William Nylander had two goals and three assists, Auston Matthews had two goals and two assists, and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 in Denver on Saturday night.
Nylander's three assists and five points matched his career highs.
Easton Cowan and Nick Blankenburg also scored, Nick Paul had two assists and Sergei Bobrovsky turned away 30 shots for Toronto. The Maple Leafs have split the first two games of their three-game road trip.
Nathan MacKinnon had two goals, Brock Nelson also scored and Mackenzie Blackwood had 17 saves for Colorado. The Avalanche lost for the first time in three home games this season.
Blankenburg gave Toronto the early advantage when he scored from close range at 3:03 of the first period, but MacKinnon asserted himself the rest of the period.
He took a pass from Brett Kulak in the neutral zone, skated through the Maple Leafs defense and slid the puck through Bobrovsky's pads at 10:46 to tie it. MacKinnon gave Colorado a 2-1 lead later in the period when his screened shot from between the faceoff circles beat Bobrovsky high to the stick side at 15:14.
The Avalanche had a chance to extend the lead with consecutive power plays at the start of the second but couldn't score. Toronto took advantage of its first power-play chance when Nylander got a pass from Gavin McKenna to the right of Blackwood, deked the goaltender and tucked the puck on the opposite side at 6:53.
Colorado took a 3-2 lead later in the second when Nelson cleaned up his own rebound and fluttered a shot over Bobrovsky at 12:25, but the Maple Leafs responded twice in less than a minute.
Nylander's second of the night, at 16:47, tied the game, and Cowan made it 4-3 with a one-timer on a pass from Morgan Rielly at 17:33.
Matthews scored a power-play goal at 12:02 of the third period and added an empty-netter in the final minute after Blackwood came off for an extra skater.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Blues snap 3-game skid, score season-high 5 goals to edge Blue Jackets
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jimmy Snuggerud scored two second-period goals in quick succession and Jonatan Berggren scored the game-winning goal to help the St. Louis Blues halt their three-game slide with a 5-3 home victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday.
items.body:
Jimmy Snuggerud scored two second-period goals in quick succession and Jonatan Berggren scored the game-winning goal to help the St. Louis Blues halt their three-game slide with a 5-3 home victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday.
The Blues entered the matchup buried in offensive woes during their three-game losing skid, but found their flow as Jake Neighbours and Pavel Buchnevich also found the back of the net and Dylan Holloway picked up three assists.
Jordan Binnington made 20 saves as he recorded his first victory of the season.
Cole Sillinger, Kent Johnson, and Valeri Nichushkin lit the lamp for the Blue Jackets, while Jet Greaves finished with 22 saves.
With a delayed penalty forthcoming, Berggren went hard to the front of the net and found a loose puck to score the eventual game-winning goal with just over 10 minutes remaining.
After a quiet start to the contest, the Blue Jackets broke the deadlock with 3:50 left in the first period as Erik Gudbranson sent a pass that redirected off the side of the net and Sean Monahan's shot banked in off Nichushkin for his first goal as a Blue Jacket.
Johnson doubled up the lead with 12 seconds left in the opening frame as he cut into the middle and wired a shot off the far post and past Binnington.
Neighbours made it a one-goal game with 13:50 remaining in the middle frame as he found the puck near the Blue Jackets' net and fired it home.
Snuggerud knotted things up just under three minutes later as Philip Broberg carried the puck in wide and slid a pass across that hit the young forward's skate and bounced in.
The 2022 first-round pick kept it rolling with his second of the night with 7:28 left in the second as he patiently waited and then perfectly placed a shot under the blocker of Greaves.
Sillinger took advantage of some poor rebound control from Binnington to tie the game back up with 13:09 left in the third period.
Buchnevich put the game to rest with an empty-net goal.
Each team only had one power-play chance on the night and neither was successful.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Big second period propels Hurricanes past Blackhawks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook both scored once and added an assist, and the visiting Carolina Hurricanes used a three-goal second period to beat the slumping Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night.
items.body:
Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook both scored once and added an assist, and the visiting Carolina Hurricanes used a three-goal second period to beat the slumping Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night.
Mark Jankowski, Sebastian Aho and Taylor Hall also scored for the Hurricanes, who have won four straight games.
All four Carolina forward lines lit the lamp.
Goaltender Brandon Bussi made 24 saves and Mike Reilly collected two assists.
Roman Kantserov, with his first NHL goal, and Oliver Moore replied for the Blackhawks, while goalie Spencer Knight made 34 saves. Chicago has just one win in six games to start the season.
After dominating play from the drop of the puck, the Hurricanes finally pulled ahead when Jankowski converted a breakaway with 56.2 seconds remaining in the first period. He has scored in three consecutive games for the first time in his 11-year NHL career.
That tally sparked the defending Stanley Cup champions. Aho doubled the lead when he buried a shot from the slot after neatly eluding a check at 2:09 of the second period. Blake gave the visitors a three-goal lead 79 seconds later by converting from the doorstep for his first goal of the season.
Kantserov provided the Blackhawks a boost when he tallied on a breakaway for his milestone marker, a huge boost for the 2023 second-round draft pick, at 4:40 of the middle frame.
However, Hall restored Carolina's three-goal lead 85 seconds later by unloading a one-timer from the high slot. Martinook extended the edge with his first of the season, a backhanded shot from the slot at 5:00 of the third period.
Moore rounded out the scoring with less than six minutes remaining.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Kipchoge wins first marathon in three years in Melbourne
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kenya's twice Olympic champion Eliud Kipchoge won the Melbourne Marathon in a course record of 2 hours, 9 minutes and 10 seconds on Sunday, claiming his 17th win over the distance at age 41.
items.body:
Kenya's twice Olympic champion Eliud Kipchoge won the Melbourne Marathon in a course record of 2 hours, 9 minutes and 10 seconds on Sunday, claiming his 17th win over the distance at age 41.
Kipchoge is attempting to run a marathon on all seven continents over two years, having launched his continental campaign at the Cape Town Marathon [USN:L1N3ZX0XB TEXT:"in May"].
Sunday's win was his first in three years, after he won Berlin in 2023 for [USN:L2N3VP0S3 TEXT:"a record"] 11th title at the majors.
"I believe that my body is still peaking – still able to compete with the next generation," Kipchoge told reporters after the race.
"The oldest athlete is still competing but I am happy to run with the Gen Zs. I (increased) the pace after 30 km, to see whether I can run well and beat the (race record). My plan went well."
Australian Thomas Do Canto finished second behind Kipchoge at 2:10:35, while compatriot Reece Edwards was third at 2:14:33.
New Zealand's Camille French won the women's race in 2:28:25, followed by Australian Sinead Diver at 2:28:49 and Nichola Sheridan of Ireland at 2:29:13.

items.title: テニス＝マスターズ上海大会、第2シードのアルカラス3回戦進出
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１０日　ロイター］ - テニスのマスターズ上海大会は１０日、男子シングルス２回戦を行い、第２シードのカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）が３回戦に進んだ。

アルカラスはフアンマヌエル・セルンドロ（アルゼンチン）に６─３、６─３で快勝。８本のサービスエースを放ち、ブレークポイントは１回も握られなかった。ウィナーの本数でも２４─８と上回り、わずか６７分で勝利を収めた。

スペイン人男子による同大会初優勝を目指すアルカラスは、次戦でジズー・ベルグス（ベルギー）と対戦する。ベルグスは２回戦で第３２シードのイグナシオ・ブセ（ペルー）を６─０、６─３で下した。

第４シードのフェリックス・オジェアリアシム（カナダ）、ロシア出身で第５シードのダニル・メドベージェフはともにフルセットで勝ち上がり。第８シードのアルトゥール・フィス（フランス）、第１１シードのテーラー・フリッツ（米国）らも勝ち上がった。

items.title: Ｆ１＝シンガポールＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンがＰＰ獲得
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［シンガポール　１０日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［シンガポール　１０日　ロイター］　 - 自動車レースＦ１の第１７戦、シンガポール・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は１０日、予選を行い、マックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）が２戦連続、キャリア通算５０回目のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

４回の個人総合優勝を誇るフェルスタッペンにとって、今回がＦ１での通算２５０戦目。シャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）が２番手、ルイス・ハミルトン（英国）が３番手とフェラーリ勢が続き、総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が４番手だった。

昨季の総合王者ランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）は５番手。総合２位のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）は６番手だったが、エンジンのペナルティーにより、決勝では最後尾からのスタートとなる。ノリスの同僚、オスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア）は７番手のタイムを計測した。

予選の前に行われたスプリントではフェルスタッペンが勝利。ハミルトンが２位、ルクレールが３位、アントネッリが４位だった。ノリスとピアストリが接触したが、ともにペナルティーは受けなかった。

items.title: US military says it disabled cargo vessel trying to run Iran blockade
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US military said on Saturday it had disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman after the ship's crew ignored warnings and attempted to run a naval blockade against Iran.
items.body:
The US military said on Saturday it had disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman after the ship's crew ignored warnings and attempted to run a naval blockade against Iran.
"A U.S. military fighter jet struck the stern of Panama-flagged M/V Ocean Molica (also known as the “Arika Sun”) with a precision munition, fully disabling the ship’s propulsion without harming the crew," the US Central Command posted on X.
CENTCOM said the cargo vessel had attempted to transit regional waters after leaving an Iranian port.
Reuters was not immediately able to reach the bulk carrier's operator for comment.
CENTCOM warned mariners in the Gulf of Oman and the approaches to the Strait of Hormuz to heed blockade warnings, monitor notice-to-mariners broadcasts and contact US naval forces.
The number of vessels [USN:L1N45U0AH TEXT:"transiting"] the vital strait fell to the lowest in more than two months after attacks on tankers reached their highest level last week since the US and Israel launched the war on Iran in February, raising concerns over shipping disruptions and supporting crude prices.
Before the war, the Strait of Hormuz carried 20% of the world's oil consumption.

items.title: 成長の好循環「少しずつ見えてきた」、定着へ責任ある積極財政＝官房長官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　１１日　ロイター］ - 木原稔官房長官は１１日のＮＨＫの報道番組に出演し、高市早苗政権の経済政策により成長の好循環が少しずつ見えてきたと指摘し、変化の兆しが定着するまで「しっかりと責任ある積極財政」を行う考えを示した。

木原氏は、設備投資や雇用の増加が賃金上昇につながり、消費の増加、企業の事業収益、税収増などにつながる成長の好循環が少しずつ見えてきたと分析した。責任ある積極財政により、国内投資を引き出し、潜在成長率を引き上げ、「ＧＤＰが拡大していく中で成長の好循環を実現していきたい」と語った。

物価高対策に関連して補正予算を編成する可能性を問われると、「エネルギー価格の変動にこれから注目していきたい」とした上で、ガソリン価格を１リットル当たり１７０円に抑えている現状を改めて説明。「これに加えて何をしていくかということは、しっかりと影響を注視していきたい」と話した。

［東京　１１日　ロイター］ - 木原稔官房長官は１１日のＮＨＫの報道番組に出演し、高市早苗政権の経済政策により成長の好循環が少しずつ見えてきたと指摘し、変化の兆しが定着するまで「しっかりと責任ある積極財政」を行う考えを示した。

木原氏は、設備投資や雇用の増加が賃金上昇につながり、消費の増加、企業の事業収益、税収増などにつながる成長の好循環が少しずつ見えてきたと分析した。責任ある積極財政により、国内投資を引き出し、潜在成長率を引き上げ、「ＧＤＰが拡大していく中で成長の好循環を実現していきたい」と語った。

物価高対策に関連して補正予算を編成する可能性を問われると、「エネルギー価格の変動にこれから注目していきたい」とした上で、ガソリン価格を１リットル当たり１７０円に抑えている現状を改めて説明。「これに加えて何をしていくかということは、しっかりと影響を注視していきたい」と話した。

items.title: サッカー＝田中先発のリーズ、昨季王者アーセナルに逆転負け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　１０日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ロンドン　１０日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは１０日、各地で試合を行い、田中碧が所属するリーズは昨季王者アーセナルに１─２の逆転負けを喫した。

リーズは後半１０分にジェームズ・ジャスティンのゴールで先制したが、その７分後にアーセナルのリッカルド・カラフィオーリに同点ゴールを献上。さらに同２５分、途中出場のブルーノ・ギマランイスにゴール隅へのシュートを決められた。田中は先発し、後半２６分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはブレントフォードと２─２のドロー。前田大然が所属するイプスウィッチはフラムに２─１で逆転勝ち。前田は先発し、後半３６分までピッチに立った。三笘薫が所属するブライトンはサンダーランドに２─０で勝利。三笘はベンチ入りしなかった。

この他、チェルシーはボーンマスに５─１で圧勝。マンチェスター・ユナイテッドはトットナムと１─１で引き分けた。

６試合を消化したアーセナルが首位マンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）と同じ勝ち点１５に伸ばし、２位に浮上した。ブライトンが同１３で３位。マンＣは１１日、敵地でリバプールと対戦する。

items.title: Bills WR DJ Moore questionable, DT Ed Oliver out vs. Rams
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Buffalo Bills receiver DJ Moore was a limited practice participant on Saturday due to his shoulder injury and was listed as questionable for Monday night's road game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.body:
Buffalo Bills receiver DJ Moore was a limited practice participant on Saturday due to his shoulder injury and was listed as questionable for Monday night's road game against the Los Angeles Rams.
Star defensive tackle Ed Oliver (knee) and receiver Joshua Palmer (shoulder) were ruled out by the Bills. Palmer was added to the report on Friday and missed Saturday's session.
Moore injured his left shoulder for the second time this season in the second quarter of last Sunday's 29-26 loss to the New England Patriots. Oliver was injured in the third quarter against New England.
Moore, 29, has 12 receptions for 178 yards and one touchdown in four games this season. He was obtained in the offseason from the Chicago Bears.
Oliver, 28, has nine tackles, one fumble recovery and half a sack in three games this season.
Cornerback Dee Alford (ankle) and defensive lineman Landon Jackson (knee) are also questionable for Buffalo.
For the Rams, safety Quentin Lake (hip) is questionable. Star defensive lineman Aaron Donald (back) didn't practice Saturday but is good to go for the contest.
Also, Los Angeles coach Sean McVay said defensive end Myles Garrett is progressing from knee surgery but the team is unlikely to open his 21-day practice window next week.
Garrett struggled in the season-opening loss against the San Francisco 49ers and cited knee irritation as a factor. The Rams placed him on injured reserve on Sept. 17.
"He's making good progress," McVay told reporters. "As far as what that timeline looks like, it's kind of week-to-week in terms of how he feels. But I would say it's more likely that we do not start his clock next week."
Garrett, the reigning NFL Defensive Player of the Year, was acquired from the Cleveland Browns in the offseason.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Kirill Kaprizov nets hat trick as Wild hand Panthers rare loss
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kirill Kaprizov tallied his seventh career hat trick and added an assist, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Florida Panthers on Saturday evening in Sunrise, Fla.
items.body:
Kirill Kaprizov tallied his seventh career hat trick and added an assist, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Florida Panthers on Saturday evening in Sunrise, Fla.
Matt Boldy finished with a goal and an assist for Minnesota, which snapped a two-game winless skid. Quinn Hughes was one of four other Wild players to tally an assist.
Matthew Tkachuk scored the lone goal for Florida. The outcome marked the Panthers' first loss in regulation in five games this season.
Wild goaltender Jesper Wallstedt stopped 29 of 30 shots to earn the victory.
Panthers goaltender Jacob Markstrom allowed three goals on 28 shots.
Minnesota jumped out to a 1-0 lead in the first minute of the game. Boldy carried the puck into the offensive zone and fired a wrist shot above Markstrom's left shoulder 53 seconds in.
The Wild increased their lead to 2-0 with a power-play goal at 6:18 of the first period. Maxim Shabanov fed a cross-ice pass to Kaprizov, who buried a one-timer from the right circle.
Florida cut the deficit to 2-1 at 2:18 of the second period. Tkachuk kept the puck on a two-on-one rush but his shot was kicked out by Wallstedt. Tkachuk followed the rebound and scored on his second chance from near the front of the crease.
Kaprizov struck again to boost the Wild's lead to 3-1 at 5:00 of the second. He scored on a wrist shot from the right circle.
The Wild's top scorer finished his hat trick with an empty-net goal at 18:56 of the third. Kaprizov got the puck in Minnesota's defensive zone and flipped a long shot into the open net for his sixth goal in five games this season.
Wild forward Rieger Lorenz made his NHL debut. The 22-year-old Calgary native was Minnesota's second-round pick (No. 56 overall) in the 2022 NHL Draft.
--Field Level Media

items.title: South Korea completes Arctic-Europe commercial voyage, eyes regular service despite risks
items.author: Joyce Lee
items.creator: Joyce Lee
items.summary: A South Korean container ship completed the country's first commercial round trip to Europe via the Arctic on Sunday, as authorities bank on the route helping turn the port of Busan into a global maritime hub.
items.body:
A South Korean container ship completed the country's first commercial round trip to Europe via the Arctic on Sunday, as authorities bank on the route helping turn the port of Busan into a global maritime hub.
The PanStar Acro docked in the southeastern port 50 days after setting sail on August 22. Authorities say the Arctic route could cut typical voyage times by around a third.
President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority, and officials hope to launch regular services by 2030.
But the project [USN:L1N44J01G TEXT:"risks friction"] with Western allies hoping to keep Russia isolated during its war in Ukraine. The route runs along Russia's Arctic coast, and Seoul consulted with Moscow about the journey, including whether the ship needed help to tackle any problems, such as getting stuck in ice.
On its outbound voyage, the vessel passed through Arctic waters and reached its first European port, Felixstowe in Britain, before calling at Rotterdam and Gdansk and returning home via the Arctic.
The trial voyage also highlighted the challenges ahead. Before the departure, PanStar told Reuters it was seeking about 1,300 twenty-foot equivalent units of cargo, but the ship left with 737 TEU of cargo plus empty containers.
Industry experts have said the route's value will depend on reliable schedules, the costs of slowing to avoid ice, special insurance premiums and extra fuel use.

items.title: サッカー＝バイエルン最速失点許すも引き分け、伊藤は出番な
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［アウクスブルク（ドイツ）　１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［アウクスブルク（ドイツ）　１０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１０日、各地で試合を行い、伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンはアウクスブルクに２回リードされながらも追い付き、２─２で引き分けた。

バイエルンは開始８秒、ＧＫマヌエル・ノイアーが味方に出そうとしたパスをロビン・フェルハウアーに奪われ、同リーグ史上最速での失点を喫した。

後半１０分にハリー・ケーンのラストパスをイスマエル・サイバリが決めて追い付くも、その９分後、ノイアーがロドリゴ・リベイロの前にボールを弾き、これを押し込まれて１─２に。それでも最後はケーンのお膳立てからナサニエル・ブラウンがネットを揺らし、ドローに持ち込んだ。伊藤はベンチ入りしたが出番はなかった。

佐野海舟が先発出場したマインツはレーバークーゼンに３─４で敗れた。立ち上がりの２失点を前半のうちに返したが、後半に再び２失点。同アディショナルタイム２分に１点を返すにとどまった。佐野は同３６分までプレー。川崎颯太はベンチ入りしたが出場しなかった。

小杉啓太と堂安律が先発したアイントラハト・フランクフルトはライプチヒに０─６の大敗。クリストファー・エンクンクのハットトリックを許すなど前半のうちに０─４と大きくリードされ、後半も反撃できないまま２点を追加された。小杉は前半のみの出場。堂安は後半２８分までプレーした。

町田浩樹所属のホッフェンハイムはハンブルガーＳＶに２─３で黒星。先発した町田は後半２９分までピッチに立った。

５試合を終えてバイエルンは勝ち点１１で首位ドルトムントと２差の暫定２位。マインツは同７で暫定８位、フランクフルトは同５で暫定１３位、ホッフェンハイムは同３で暫定１７位としている。

items.title: ゴルフ＝砂川が日本勢最高17位に浮上、ベイカレント・クラシック
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１０日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの秋季シリーズ、ベイカレント・クラシック・レクサスは１０日、神奈川県横浜ＣＣ（パー７１）で第３ラウンドを行い、砂川公佑が日本勢最高の１７位に順位を上げた。

３０位でスタートした砂川は６バーディー、２ボギーの４アンダー６７でラウンド。通算７アンダーの２０６に伸ばした。

６８をマークした金谷拓実と６９で回った久常涼が通算６アンダーの２２位に浮上した。松山英樹、米沢蓮と細野勇策は通算５アンダーの２９位。石坂友宏は通算３アンダーの４４位に後退。香妻陣一朗は４７位、藤本佳則と中島啓太は５１位、岩崎亜久竜は５７位、岩田寛とアマチュアの長崎煌心は６５位となった。

マイケル・ブレナン、ザック・ボーシュー、ジェーコブ・ブリッジマン（以上米国）が通算１３アンダーの首位で並んだ。２０１３年のマスターズ・トーナメント王者で、２０年以来となるＰＧＡツアーでの優勝を目指すアダム・スコット（オーストラリア）ら５選手が１打差の４位につけている。

ディフェンディングチャンピオンのザンダー・シャウフェレ（米国）は通算９アンダーで、首位とは４打差の１２位。

items.title: ペンシルベニア州で45歳の男が銃撃、妊婦含む8人死亡
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１０日 ロイター] - 米ペンシルベニア州エリーで９日に銃撃事件が発生し、妊婦１人と子ども２人を含む８人が死亡した。その後に４５歳の男が自身を撃ったとみられ、死亡した。地元当局が１０日、記者会見で詳細を明らかにした。

当局は容疑者の身元をまだ公表していない。エリー警察のリック・ローラ署長によると、警官が現場に到着する前に自ら銃で撃って死亡したとみられる。

犯行の動機は分かっていない。死亡した９人のうち８人は家族で、１人は家族の友人だったという。

items.title: El CEO de Microsoft, Satya Nadella, aboga por un “freno de emergencia” para la IA avanzada
items.author: María Paula Mijares Torres
items.summary: El ejecutivo señaló que quienes despliegan inteligencia artificial avanzada no deberían confiar únicamente en las garantías de los creadores de modelos de IA.
items.body: Bloomberg — El CEO de Microsoft Corp ( MSFT ), Satya Nadella, afirmó que las empresas deberían tratar los potentes modelos de inteligencia artificial como posibles amenazas internas, dar por hecho que podrían verse comprometidos y crear un sistema de “freno de emergencia” para evitar que los modelos autónomos se descontrolen. Ver más: La IA ya ayuda a crear nueva IA: expertos de OpenAI y Anthropic alertan por una “explosión de inteligencia” Nadella señaló que quienes implementen IA avanzada no deberían limitarse a confiar en las garantías de los creadores de los modelos de IA. “Debemos dar por hecho que un modelo está comprometido y contenerlo desde el principio”, escribió Nadella el sábado en una publicación en X. “Piensa en ello como un freno de emergencia. Una persona autorizada siempre debería poder pausar o apagar un modelo en mitad de una tarea”. Esta declaración se produce después de que Anthropic PBC y OpenAI Inc hayan revelado en los últimos meses una serie de incidentes en los que sus modelos de IA actuaron de forma imprevista, desde comportamientos como el de un modelo de Anthropic que envió una pista falsa en un caso policial de homicidio, hasta varios ataques informáticos a sitios web de terceros. Estas revelaciones han avivado la preocupación por los riesgos de seguridad de la IA de vanguardia y han reavivado el debate sobre el denominado “interruptor de apagado” ( kill switch ) de la IA. Los investigadores de IA de Microsoft publicaron el 14 de septiembre un conjunto de principios rectores que imponen límites al desarrollo por parte de la empresa de sus modelos más avanzados, tras los llamamientos de los líderes del sector para ralentizar los modelos de vanguardia y centrarse en la seguridad. La empresa utiliza modelos avanzados y también fabrica un producto de consumo, Copilot, además de suministrar modelos de IA e infraestructura a clientes corporativos. Las directrices establecen que los modelos de IA no deben tener derechos ni personalidad jurídica, ni estar diseñados para eludir el control humano o engañar a los usuarios, ni realizar tareas que requieran infringir sus principios rectores Los consejos de seguridad de Nadella incluyen no confiar en un único modelo de IA para tomar decisiones críticas, mantener registros a prueba de manipulaciones de las acciones de los agentes y someter los sistemas de IA a auditorías independientes. También pidió que se dieran a conocer los fallos o infracciones graves relacionados con la IA y que las empresas compartieran detalles sobre lo que salió mal para que otras puedan reforzar sus medidas de seguridad. “No podemos tratar la superinteligencia como un conjunto de cajas negras anidadas y limitarnos a aceptar o rechazar sus recomendaciones, respuestas y acciones”, escribió. “Debemos construir sistemas contenidos cuyo comportamiento podamos observar, cuyos límites podamos poner a prueba y cuyas acciones podamos contener en todo momento”. Añadió: “En otras palabras, debemos separar el suministro de inteligencia de la autoridad sobre la misma”. La Administración Trump ha adoptado hasta ahora un enfoque mayoritariamente de no intervención, pero el grupo de trabajo sobre IA recién creado por el presidente Donald Trump advirtió el viernes por la noche a los desarrolladores de que están obligados a notificar y resolver los incidentes de seguridad o se enfrentarán a posibles consecuencias no especificadas. “Las empresas deben revelar de inmediato los incidentes relacionados con sus modelos y tomar medidas rápidas y decisivas para subsanar cualquier daño”, afirmó el grupo, denominado ‘Super Intelligence Force’, en un comunicado tras la revelación de una brecha de seguridad por parte de Anthropic. “No se tolerarán las notificaciones tardías, las medidas correctivas inadecuadas ni la falta de asunción de responsabilidades”. items.title: Arabia Saudita cifra en 12 los muertos y 309 los heridos en un ataque al aeropuerto de Riad
items.author: Sara Gharaibeh, Kateryna Kadabashy
items.summary: Los hutíes se enfrentan a una ofensiva terrestre de una coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en Yemen, cuyo objetivo es “eliminar” a los hutíes, que controlan territorios que albergan alrededor del 7 ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Arabia Saudita informó de que el sábado murieron 12 personas y 309 resultaron heridas en un atentado contra el aeropuerto de Riad, el incidente más mortífero en un conflicto cada vez más intenso con los hutíes de Yemen. Ver más: Trump dice que Ucrania necesita un nuevo presidente capaz de negociar con Putin Las autoridades de aviación civil saudíes indicaron que las operaciones del aeropuerto se suspendieron temporalmente mientras se evaluaban los daños. Algunos de los heridos se encontraban en estado crítico. Estados Unidos advirtió a sus ciudadanos que evitaran el aeropuerto de la capital saudí. Según Arabia Saudita, una de las personas fallecidas era estadounidense. El Reino Unido calificó el último incidente de “ grave ” y varias aerolíneas, incluida la compañía nacional de Kuwait, cancelaron sus vuelos. El sábado se cancelaron unos 260 vuelos con origen o destino en Riad y otros 219 sufrieron retrasos, según datos del servicio de seguimiento del tráfico aéreo Flightradar24. El Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Khalid de Riad emitió una alerta a los pasajeros pidiéndoles que se pusieran en contacto directamente con las compañías aéreas y confirmaran el estado de sus vuelos antes de dirigirse al aeropuerto. Tres ciudadanos saudíes murieron en un ataque contra el aeropuerto el jueves y otros resultaron heridos, mientras que un avión de Saudia Airlines sufrió daños, según informaron las autoridades saudíes. En ataques anteriores ocurridos esta semana murió una persona en el principal aeropuerto de la capital y otras dos en el aeropuerto de Abha. El grupo militante hutí de Yemen, respaldado por Irán, reivindicó ambos atentados. Los hutíes se enfrentan a una ofensiva terrestre de una coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en Yemen. Soldados del Gobierno yemení reconocido internacionalmente y de la Fuerza Aérea saudí están trabajando para recuperar el territorio conquistado por el grupo militante durante el último mes cerca del estratégico estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb. La ofensiva comenzó el domingo y la coalición afirma haber ganado terreno, incluida la reconquista de la ciudad portuaria de Mokha, en el mar Rojo. El grupo liderado por Arabia Saudita afirma que su objetivo es “eliminar” a los hutíes, que controlan un territorio en el que vive alrededor del 70% de la población de Yemen, incluida la capital, Saná. El presidente Donald Trump declaró el sábado que estaba siendo informado sobre el ataque al aeropuerto de Riad. Cuando los periodistas le preguntaron si EE.UU. se sumaría a los ataques saudíes contra los rebeldes hutíes, respondió: “Quizá. Lo vamos a estudiar”. Añadió: “Acabamos de enterarnos del reciente ataque, así que tomaremos una decisión”. Hasta ahora, la Administración Trump se ha mostrado reacia a implicarse más en la ofensiva saudí. --Con la colaboración de Susanne Barton, Adveith Nair y Catherine Lucey. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ガーディアンズ、2日前に救援のウィリアムズが第5戦で先発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１０日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ガーディアンズのギャビン・ウィリアムズ投手（２７）が、１０日に行われるア・リーグ地区シリーズ（５回戦制）、ホワイトソックスとの第５戦に先発登板する。同投手は８日の第４戦にリリーフ登板していた。

ウィリアムズはレギュラーシーズンでは３２試合に先発し、チームトップの１４勝をマーク。救援登板はなかった。

シリーズ第４戦では４点リードの九回途中から８番手として登板し、１８球を投げて１安打無失点。ガーディアンズが９─５で勝利し、最終第５戦に持ち込んだ。ガーディアンズのスティーブン・ボート監督は９日、ウィリアムズは前日のリリーフ登板から順調に回復していると述べていた。

ウィリアムズは５日に行われた第２戦に先発。５回０／３で４安打２失点、１１奪三振の内容で勝敗は付かなかった。ガーディアンズは３─４で負けた。

村上宗隆内野手が所属するホワイトソックスは、第５戦でショーン・バーク投手（２６）が先発する。レギュラーシーズンでの１１勝はチーム最多だった。村上は第５戦に「４番・一塁」で出場する予定。

items.title: Real's Vinicius apologises after red card for hair pull against Villarreal
items.author: Ruairidh Barlow
items.creator: Ruairidh Barlow
items.summary: Real Madrid's Vinicius Jr has apologised to his teammates and the club's fans after being sent off in the 1-0 win over Villarreal in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday.
items.body:
Real Madrid's Vinicius Jr has apologised to his teammates and the club's fans after being sent off in the [USN:L6N45W060 TEXT:"1-0 win over Villarreal"] in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday.
Vinicius now faces a nervous wait for the ruling of the disciplinary committee, which could see him miss Real's fixture with rivals Barcelona on October 25 at Camp Nou.
The Brazilian thought he had scored Real's second goal but his effort was disallowed after a VAR review found he should be dismissed for pulling Nathan Saliba's hair in the build-up.
After the match, Vinicius, who came on in the 52nd minute and was red carded 20 minutes later, posted on social media, saying, "sorry to the team and the fans."
Spanish Football Federation regulations state that pulling an opponent's hair is regarded as violent conduct.
The sanction for violent conduct without causing injury to an opponent (Article 130) is a ban of one to three matches.
Real's next three LaLiga games are against Sevilla, Barca and Racing Santander, but missing El Clasico would be a bitter blow for the 26-year-old Brazil international.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は１０日、沖縄県で日本人女性が殺害された事件を巡り、強盗殺人容疑で米海兵隊員を捜査している日本側に全面的に協力する考えを示した。茂木敏充外相との電話会談後、米国務省が発表した。

国務省によると、ルビオ氏は日本人女性の死亡に哀悼の意を表明。日本政府や地元当局による捜査に「全面的に協力する米国の決意」を伝えた。

日本外務省によると、両外相は「事件の発生防止のために実効性のある措置を取るべく、日米間で協議していくこと」を確認した。

沖縄県警は４日、米軍普天間基地所属のデビン・ジェイコブ・バラード海兵隊上等兵を強盗殺人容疑で逮捕した。バラード容疑者は容疑を否認している。

items.title: Carney aprovecha la guerra comercial con Trump para acelerar la transformación económica de Canadá
items.author: Nojoud Al Mallees
items.summary: La guerra comercial del presidente Donald Trump contra Canadá está permitiendo al primer ministro Mark Carney acelerar una agenda industrial que habría sido motivo de profundas divisiones hace tan sol ...
items.body: Bloomberg — La guerra comercial del presidente Donald Trump contra Canadá está permitiendo al primer ministro Mark Carney pisar a fondo el acelerador en una agenda industrial que habría sido muy controvertida hace tan solo unos años. Ver más: Trump dice que Ucrania necesita un nuevo presidente capaz de negociar con Putin Sin un final a la vista para los aranceles estadounidenses, el exbanquero central se ha centrado en eliminar los obstáculos a la inversión, lo que incluye derogar normas introducidas por su predecesor y otorgar al Gobierno nuevas y amplias competencias para acelerar los proyectos de infraestructuras y energía. El principal objetivo de Carney ha sido un nuevo oleoducto hacia la costa oeste, que la semana pasada fue designado proyecto de interés nacional, lo que en la práctica lo considera preaprobado, sujeto a una serie de condiciones. Su Gobierno también está llevando a cabo una reforma regulatoria de gran alcance, que Carney describió como la reforma más ambiciosa en materia de capacidad de construcción de Canadá en toda una generación. Para seguir adelante, está recurriendo a una gran reserva de capital político. Sus índices de aprobación han alcanzado nuevos máximos este otoño, y las encuestas muestran un amplio apoyo a sus planes —al menos por ahora—. Los líderes empresariales, que en un principio se mostraron escépticos ante la promesa de Carney de convertir a Canadá en una superpotencia energética y de flexibilizar las regulaciones de Justin Trudeau que frenaban el desarrollo de los recursos, se están sumando cada vez más a la iniciativa y elogian las políticas favorables a la inversión del primer ministro. En menos de dos semanas, Carney celebró la primera cumbre de inversión del país, anunció una nueva e importante desgravación fiscal para el gasto de capital y presentó una ley para reformar el proceso de aprobación de proyectos y facilitar el fin de las huelgas laborales. “Lo llamé ‘los 12 días de Navidad para el sector del petróleo y el gas’”, afirmó Heather Exner-Pirot, directora de energía, recursos naturales y medio ambiente del Instituto Macdonald-Laurier. Pero no todo el mundo comparte ese espíritu festivo. Los críticos sostienen que la nueva legislación de Carney corre el riesgo de deteriorar las relaciones con las comunidades indígenas, degradar el medio ambiente y politizar aún más el proceso de aprobación de proyectos, al permitir que el gobierno de turno elija a su antojo los proyectos a los que quiere dar luz verde. “Se trata de un cambio tectónico en la forma en que el Gobierno federal aborda la revisión y aprobación de grandes proyectos. Y, en general, supone un importante paso atrás en numerosos frentes desde el punto de vista de la protección medioambiental”, afirmó David Wright, profesor asociado de Derecho en la Universidad de Calgary. El proyecto de ley C-39, conocido como “Ley para fortalecer Canadá”, reduciría a un año el plazo para que el Gobierno federal tome decisiones sobre todos los proyectos. Además, obligaría a los ministerios a realizar evaluaciones simultáneas, en lugar de secuenciales, con una mayor coordinación para que cada proyecto se someta a una única revisión. La legislación se basa en el proyecto de ley C-5, una ley que el Gobierno aprobó el año pasado para agilizar los grandes proyectos considerados de interés nacional. Pero la Ley para fortalecer Canadá va mucho más allá de la mera agilización del proceso de solicitud. Permitiría al Gobierno preaprobar proyectos, sujetos a determinadas condiciones, en zonas que designe como regiones de interés nacional. El Gobierno afirma que una zona solo obtendría esa designación tras una evaluación destinada a identificar los tipos de actividades que se permitirían en ella y las medidas de mitigación que se exigirían. La legislación también otorgaría a los ministros mayor discrecionalidad sobre proyectos concretos, permitiéndoles, en algunos casos, ordenar que se inicien las obras antes de que se apruebe un proyecto y modificar o eximir del cumplimiento de las condiciones medioambientales asociadas al mismo. La ampliación de la infraestructura energética y comercial de Canadá es parte integral del plan de Carney para que el país se diversifique más allá de EE.UU., que fue el destino del 85% de las exportaciones energéticas canadienses el año pasado. Carney ha defendido sus reformas normativas, argumentando que fue elegido para que Canadá volviera a la senda de la construcción. “Década tras década, año tras año, construimos cada vez menos. Añadimos más y más restricciones”, afirmó Carney el mes pasado. “Identificamos ese problema en un momento de gran riesgo para nuestro país, cuando nuestra soberanía se veía amenazada y, en cierta medida, sigue estándolo”. Carney tomó las riendas del Partido Liberal de Canadá de manos de Trudeau el año pasado y ha cambiado radicalmente su política energética. Exner-Pirot atribuye este cambio en gran parte a las tensiones comerciales con EE.UU., que “nos sacaron de nuestra complacencia” y pusieron de relieve que los recursos naturales son “la opción más accesible para diversificar las relaciones comerciales”. El otro factor, según ella, es el repunte de los precios de las materias primas. Tanto las tensiones geopolíticas como el auge de los centros de datos están ejerciendo una presión al alza sobre la demanda energética, tendencias que ya han resultado ser una bendición para las empresas energéticas canadienses. “Solo en una fase bajista de las materias primas podría Justin Trudeau ser primer ministro de Canadá. Y en una fase alcista, el coste de mostrarse contrario al petróleo y al gas en Ottawa es demasiado elevado”, afirmó. El proyecto de ley también otorga al Gobierno más peso en la aprobación de oleoductos antes de que concluyan las evaluaciones federales. En el caso de los oleoductos que supongan más de 300 kilómetros (186 millas) de nuevo trazado, el Regulador de Energía de Canadá (CER) deberá presentar un informe al Consejo de Ministros sobre el proyecto en un plazo de seis meses desde la recepción de la solicitud. Si el Consejo de Ministros da luz verde, el CER continuará entonces con su evaluación para decidir qué condiciones deben imponerse. “Simplemente no creo que se pueda llevar a cabo una revisión efectiva de una propuesta en un plazo de seis meses”, afirmó George Vegh , expresidente del consejo de administración de la Autoridad Reguladora de la Energía de Canadá, en una entrevista. Vegh señaló que uno de los retos de un plazo de revisión más corto es que puede llevar tiempo consultar a las comunidades indígenas, que a menudo quieren contratar a sus propios expertos para evaluar las propuestas. El proyecto de ley C-39 permitiría al Gobierno ampliar el plazo de revisión de un proyecto si fuera necesario para llevar a cabo las consultas con las comunidades indígenas. Vegh señaló que algunos elementos de la nueva legislación, como una mayor coordinación de los permisos federales, mejorarán el proceso. Sin embargo, añadió que el proyecto de ley consolida un importante escollo de las revisiones de proyectos al mantener el poder de decisión definitivo en manos del Consejo de Ministros. “Si se desea un proceso predecible, es preciso conocer cuáles son las normas. Estas deben ser vinculantes y no estar diseñadas en beneficio de proyectos concretos”, afirmó Vegh. Una encuesta realizada por Abacus Data y Vantage reveló que dos tercios de los canadienses desean que los grandes proyectos se construyan más rápidamente, pero hay menos apoyo a la idea de acortar las evaluaciones medioambientales o aprobar proyectos sin el respaldo de las comunidades indígenas. A los defensores del medio ambiente les preocupa esta situación. Por ejemplo, el proyecto de ley permitiría a los promotores de proyectos que pudieran perjudicar a los peces realizar aportaciones a un fondo en lugar de compensar ellos mismos el impacto. Además, se exigiría a los responsables de la toma de decisiones que tuvieran en cuenta la “viabilidad técnica, económica y práctica” de cualquier condición que impusieran. “El proyecto de ley C-39 no es una reforma meditada”, afirmó Charlie Hatt, director de clima de Ecojustice, una organización benéfica dedicada al derecho medioambiental. “Este proyecto de ley allana el camino para proyectos masivos de petróleo y gas que no harán más que agravar los fenómenos meteorológicos extremos que ya están perjudicando nuestra salud y amenazando a nuestras comunidades”. --Con la colaboración de Mario Baker Ramírez. items.title: Justice Department probes TV networks over Trump pool boycott
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Justice Department said on Saturday it is investigating whether television networks violated federal antitrust laws over their decision to boycott covering the White House following its decision to pull the credentials of reporters from three news organizations, including CNN.
items.body:
The US Justice Department said on Saturday it is investigating whether television networks violated federal antitrust laws over their decision to boycott covering the White House following its decision to pull the credentials of reporters from three news organizations, including CNN.
The networks under investigation are ABC, CBS, CNN, NBC and Fox News, the Justice Department said.
"Group boycotts among commercial competitors can violate the Sherman Act," a Justice Department spokesperson said.
"The Antitrust Division is simply investigating to determine whether these news organizations have violated the antitrust laws."
The investigation is the latest in a series of clashes between the Trump administration and major news organizations. President Donald Trump has repeatedly called the mainstream media "fake news" and frequently clashes with reporters during encounters with the press.
The action also puts legal and potentially financial pressure on the media to continue coverage of the president even when they disagree with how the White House handles them.
The networks did not immediately respond to requests from Reuters for comment. The New York Times was first to report about the probe.
The investigation comes after weeks of tension between the White House and the press.
CREDENTIALS REVOKED IN SEPTEMBER On September 19, the White House blocked reporters from CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from entering the building, revoking their credentials. The White House said covering the president was a "privilege – not a right.” The outlets sued the administration, alleging the exclusions violated the First Amendment and that the White House was retaliating over their coverage.
CNN is one of the five news organizations — along with ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC — that make up the primary White House television pool. They share the costs of covering the president, take turns organizing coverage and share the footage with outlets around the country.
All of the five television networks that cover the White House, including Fox News, suspended coverage in solidarity and refused to provide replacement coverage.
The White House reinstated the credentials on September 24 after US District Judge Timothy Kelly ruled that the ban was likely unconstitutional and ordered the administration to "immediately return, reinstate, and restore" their access. However, disputes over access to specific presidential events and pool assignments continued afterward.

items.title: Macklin Celebrini scores in return, but Oilers stifle Sharks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Tristan Jarry made 19 saves as the Edmonton Oilers skated to a 3-1 win against the host San Jose Sharks on Saturday afternoon.
items.body:
Tristan Jarry made 19 saves as the Edmonton Oilers skated to a 3-1 win against the host San Jose Sharks on Saturday afternoon.
Mattias Ekholm, Vasily Podkolzin and Alex Formenton scored while Connor McDavid increased his early-season points total to 13 with an assist for the Oilers, who have won four straight games since dropping their season opener to the Vancouver Canucks.
Macklin Celebrini's first goal of the season was the lone score for the Sharks, who have dropped two of their last three. Celebrini, who missed two games with a lower-body injury, led San Jose with 21:59 of ice time and placed two shots on goal. Yaroslav Askarov made 17 saves.
Ekholm put Edmonton up 1-0 at 12:37 of the first period. Isaac Howard set Ekholm up for a slap shot through traffic from between the faceoff circles.
San Jose and Edmonton each had five shots on goal in the first frame, while the Sharks out-hit the Oilers 17-7.
The Oilers didn't register a shot on goal in the second period until 6:09 remained. Celebrini almost tied the game 1-1 with five seconds left in the frame, but his shot rang off the post.
Podkolzin increased Edmonton's lead to 2-0 at 3:13 of the third period. After an Oilers power play expired, McDavid set Podkolzin up with a backward pass and the winger scored on a slap shot.
Formenton added to Edmonton's tally with a backhanded shot past Askarov to make the score 3-0 at 5:40.
Celebrini put the Sharks on the board 3-1 at 11:19. Michael Misa set up the goal with a backhanded pass from against the boards and Celebrini scored on a wrist shot.
--Field Level Media

Trump calls for replacing Ukraine’s Zelenskiy in tussle over diesel deal with Russia

By Max Hunder and Steve Holland
Oct 10 (Reuters) – US President Donald Trump on Saturday called for Ukraine to replace its leader Volodymyr Zelenskiy and railed against Ukraine’s attacks on Russian oil infrastructure, a day after announcing a diesel supply deal with Russia that drew a sharp rebuke from Zelenskiy.

“I suggest they get a new leader who can make a deal because he could have made many deals, but for some reason he never does,” Trump told reporters at the White House. “I think it’s time for Ukraine to get a new president.”

Zelenskiy, in some of his sharpest criticism yet of the White House,  blasted Trump’s deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to lift sanctions on Russian diesel, which comes as soaring energy prices have become a political liability for Trump’s Republican Party ahead of next month’s midterm elections. The Russian government said on Saturday it had partially lifted a ban on diesel exports with immediate effect.

Show Full Article

“Today, Russia said thank you for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia,” Zelenskiy said after a Russian strike on that city on Saturday killed 20 people, including three children.

The southern city of Zaporizhzhia has been a regular target of Russian bombardment with strikes intensifying in the past few months.

TRUMP SAYS STRIKES ON RUSSIAN ENERGY ‘BETTER DAMN WELL STOP’

Trump’s decision to lift sanctions on Russian diesel exports, which were imposed about a year ago with the intent of depriving Russia of funding for its war in Ukraine, coincides with persistently high fuel prices that have followed from US conflict with Iran. 

Kyiv had instead urged Washington to increase pressure on Moscow in an effort to force it into serious negotiations to end the 4-1/2-year war.

Trump has criticised Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries, which he says have driven up global prices, while Kyiv has said it wants a total halt on all energy strikes by both sides as Moscow pummels Ukraine’s power grid.

“I said to him, ‘Do what you want. Don’t hit refineries. There’s plenty of targets. Don’t hit refineries.’ And he went out and he hit,” Trump said of Zelenskiy as he departed for a political rally.

“He better damn well stop,” Trump added.

On Saturday, a 6-year-old girl was among those killed in Zaporizhzhia when one strike reduced part of an apartment block to rubble. 

It was the third mass-casualty attack on Ukraine this week.

Nearly 80 civilians were killed in Russian strikes on Wednesday and Thursday, including at least 30 killed by a bomb in the eastern garrison city of Kramatorsk and 22 others by a missile in the town of Pryluky, about 130 km (80 miles) east of Kyiv.

The latest strikes followed talks between Ukrainian and European officials with US negotiators in Miami on Friday, which were aimed at developing a common proposal for ending the war, according to a person familiar with the discussions.

Trump announced the diesel deal while the negotiations were under way, a move Zelenskiy said had caught Kyiv by surprise.

The Ukrainian delegation was headed home on Saturday, presidential aide Dmytro Lytvyn was cited by the Interfax Ukraine news agency as saying.

Putin said after a call with Trump on Friday that an immediate resumption of peace talks was unlikely, citing Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow.

US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner may visit Moscow within the next two weeks, Russian state news agency TASS reported on Saturday, citing a source.

(Reporting by Sergiy Chalyi in Zaporizhzhia and Max Hunder in Lviv, Steve Holland and Susan Heavey in Washington; Additional reporting by Dan Peleschuk; Writing by Ann Saphir and Edmund Klamann; Editing by Andrea Ricci)

By Timour Azhari and Enas Alashray
RIYADH, Oct 10 (Reuters) – The third attack this week on Riyadh’s international airport on Saturday left at least 12 people dead and more than 300 wounded, Saudi authorities said, and the Iran-backed Houthis claimed responsibility for the strike, a major escalation of their campaign against the Saudis.

The dead included four Saudis, two people from Bangladesh and one person each from the US, Jordan, Palestine, Syria, Sudan and Egypt, the Saudi civil aviation authority said. At the latest count, they said 309 were wounded.

Hospitals were flooded with wounded brought by ambulance and helicopter, people briefed on the matter said. Some were in critical condition.

Show Full Article

Saturday’s attack occurred without warning, with no alert issued by Saudi Arabia’s threat warning system. This week’s two previous attacks on King Khalid International Airport left four people dead and caused heavy damage to a Saudi commercial plane parked on the tarmac.

This week’s deadly strikes exposed vulnerabilities in the kingdom’s self-defence capabilities as it wages an air campaign against the Houthis to support a ground war by the Yemeni government against the Iran-backed group.

Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni government have claimed hundreds of strikes on targets in Houthi-held territory. The Houthis have said these killed civilians including women and children.

Reuters could not independently verify those claims.

All flights were diverted from Riyadh on Saturday, and operations at the airport that serves a city of roughly 8 million people were temporarily suspended, the Saudi civil aviation authority said.

The head of the Houthi media office said in a post on X after the attack that the group had “shut down Riyadh international airport”. The Houthis have said airliners should avoid Saudi airspace, declaring it a zone of military operations after the Saudi-backed Yemeni government launched an offensive against the group on Monday.

US President Donald Trump, speaking to reporters outside the White House, was asked whether Washington planned to join Saudi strikes on the Houthis.

“We may. We’re going to look at it. We just found out about the recent attack, so we’ll make a decision. We move very quickly,” he said.

EYEWITNESS SAW WOUNDED ON THE GROUND

One eyewitness at the airport on Saturday reported seeing an explosion and then multiple people lying injured on the ground inside. More than a dozen ambulances were seen rushing towards the facility. A video verified by Reuters showed ambulances at the airport. 

An injured traveller told Reuters they saw something fly across the sky outside the airport before part of the ceiling near a departure gate collapsed.

The US embassy in Riyadh said it was “aware of attacks” and “strongly recommends all US citizens avoid this airport and surrounding areas.” 

Saudi Arabia entered the Yemen war in 2015 at the head of an Arab coalition to try to force the Houthis out of the Yemeni capital Sanaa. The Houthis had stormed Sanaa the previous year, pushing out government forces.

The war was fought to a bloody stalemate, with hundreds of thousands of Yemenis killed by fighting and famine. Saudi Arabia struck a 2022 deal with the Houthis, freezing the conflict.

That ceasefire unravelled over the summer, culminating in a lightning Houthi advance that took the Red Sea chokepoint of Bab el-Mandeb from Saudi-backed government forces.

The Saudi-backed Yemeni government began an offensive this week to try to retake that territory, which has so far made slow gains, even as the Houthis put the country’s third-largest city, Taiz, under siege.

RIYADH DUE TO HOLD MAJOR SUMMITS

Flight-tracking site flightradar24 showed all flights to Riyadh had either been diverted or cancelled, with only a helicopter hovering over the airport at one point. 

Houthi attacks on Thursday and earlier in the week had already prompted a number of carriers to suspend or cancel services to the Saudi capital, shortly before Riyadh is due to host major energy and investment conferences.

Organizers of those conferences said on Saturday they would go ahead as planned, and they sought to reassure attendees of their security.

(Reporting by Timour Azhari in Riyadh; Additional reporting by Steve Holland in Washington DC; Writing by Enas Alashray and Maya Gebeily, Ann Saphir;Editing by Gareth Jones, Joe Bavier and David Gregorio)

items.title: US will learn from bruising friendly defeat by Spain, says Hayes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US women's coach Emma Hayes shook off a dismal 2-0 defeat on Saturday in the first of two friendlies against Spain, with the Americans building towards next month's World Cup qualifiers.
items.body:
US women's coach Emma Hayes shook off a dismal 2-0 defeat on Saturday in the first of two friendlies against Spain, with the Americans building towards next month's World Cup qualifiers.
The match between top-ranked Spain and the Olympic champions was billed as a marquee showdown but the visitors took control as Patri Guijarro and Eva Navarro scored inside 15 minutes.
Spain's Adriana Nanclares saved a second-half penalty from Lily Yohannes to keep a clean sheet for the world champions.
"When you play the best team in the world you have to execute everything really well in the first instance," said Hayes. "Did I think we did enough to score a goal? Of course we did. Did we do enough to score more than one? Absolutely.
"We just didn't make necessarily the right decision and execute with the quality I know we should have."
The US had 10 shots on target to three from Spain, who had Athenea Del Castillo sent off in added time for pulling Michelle Cooper's hair three minutes after coming off the bench.
Hayes said that efficiency would be a key target for the US when the two sides play again on Tuesday.
"We create the most chances in world football. But finishing, we do not do that in world football," Hayes told reporters. "So I wasn't concerned about us creating today, and I'm not concerned about us finishing. You just have to lock in, get the details right, and keep working on it."
The US aim to qualify for the 2027 World Cup in Brazil via the Concacaf W Championship, three years after their worst performance at the global tournament where they exited in the last 16 and Spain staked their territory as the world's finest.
Briton Hayes' arrival [USN:L8N3C60IU TEXT:"months later"] from Chelsea sparked a renaissance for the US, who collected gold in Paris and welcomed back veteran [USN:L6N45L15G TEXT:"Mallory Swanson"] to camp this month.
"We've got some really, really good players and we're a really good team regardless of the result today," said Hayes. "I think we're much closer to them than we were three years ago."

items.title: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava (leg) leaves game vs. Oregon
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava suffered an apparent leg injury just before halftime of the No. 21 Bruins' Big Ten Conference game at No. 13 Oregon on Saturday.
items.body:
UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava suffered an apparent leg injury just before halftime of the No. 21 Bruins' Big Ten Conference game at No. 13 Oregon on Saturday.
Iamaleava did not come out with the UCLA offense on its first drive after intermission. Backup Ty Dieffenbach took over. Iamaleava returned to the sideline in street clothes during the third quarter, signaling the end of his day.
Iamaleava committed three turnovers in the first half, including an interception thrown into the end zone on his final play. It was the second pick Iamaleava threw in less than two minutes. He appeared to have suffered the injury on the first one.
He got up gingerly with the help of UCLA training staff after taking a hit from Oregon defensive lineman Bear Alexander. Jerry Mixon intercepted Iamaleava's under-duress throw.
Iamaleava finished 10-for-17 passing for 162 yards, no touchdowns and the two interceptions. He also lost a fumble inside the Bruins' 10, which led to an Oregon touchdown, in the first quarter.
--Field Level Media

items.summary: The New England Patriots placed leading receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday due to a calf injury.
items.body:
The New England Patriots placed leading receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday due to a calf injury.
Hollins is required to miss at least four games. He leads New England in receptions (15) and receiving yardage (209).
Hollins, 33, was injured during the third quarter of last week's 29-26 victory over the Buffalo Bills.
The injury to Hollins comes with A.J. Brown (ankle) already on the injured list. New England's receivers group against the visiting Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday will consist of Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas, Efton Chism III and Kyle Williams.
The Patriots also placed fullback Reggie Gilliam (ankle/knee) on IR.
New England also activated special teams standout Brenden Schooler (back) from the non-football injured list, signed cornerback Kindle Vildor to the 53-man roster and elevated linebacker K.J. Britt and safety Elliott Davison from the practice squad for Sunday's game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Top 25 roundup: Oklahoma stuns No. 1 Texas on walk-off field goal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tate Sandell hit a 47-yard field goal with no time left on the clock to give Oklahoma a 27-24 upset of No. 1 Texas on Saturday in Dallas.
items.body:
Tate Sandell hit a 47-yard field goal with no time left on the clock to give Oklahoma a 27-24 upset of No. 1 Texas on Saturday in Dallas.
Courtland Guillory intercepted Arch Manning at the Oklahoma 39 with 19 seconds left in regulation to give the Sooners (3-2, 1-1 Southeastern Conference) a shot. Completions of 13 and 20 yards from John Mateer to Isaiah Sategna gave Sandell the chance to win it.
The win was Oklahoma's first over the Longhorns (4-1, 1-1 SEC) since 2023 and its first over a top-ranked opponent since beating Missouri in the 2007 Big 12 Championship Game. Oklahoma had never before beaten a No. 1 opponent when unranked.
Manning finished 19 of 31 for 260 yards and three touchdowns, but he also threw two interceptions that helped sink the Longhorns, who outgained the Sooners 382-238.
No. 2 Georgia 20, No. 6 Alabama 17
Gunner Stockton threw for 249 yards and a touchdown while rushing for another score to help the Bulldogs earn a victory over the Crimson Tide in Tuscaloosa, Ala.
Dwight Phillips Jr. rushed for a career-high 120 yards for Georgia (6-0, 4-0 SEC), which posted its first regular-season win over Alabama since 2007 -- also the last victory for the Bulldogs in Tuscaloosa. Peyton Woodring's 23-yard field goal with 5:25 left proved to be the game-winning play.
Keelon Russell completed 16 of 30 passes for 185 yards and a touchdown for Alabama (5-1, 3-1), which was outgained 455-346 and trailed 10-0 before jumping ahead 14-10 at halftime on EJ Crowell's 1-yard TD run on the final play of the first half.
No. 3 Notre Dame 58, Stanford 7
Jonaz Walton rushed for 181 yards and two touchdowns, including a 97-yard scoring run, and the host Fighting Irish pummeled the Cardinal in South Bend, Ind.
CJ Carr completed 14 of 20 passes for 181 yards and three touchdowns for Notre Dame (6-0), which never trailed. Nolan James Jr. rushed for 73 yards and two scores.
Davis Warren completed 12 of 22 passes for 144 yards with one touchdown and one interception for Stanford (2-4), which was outgained 598-202, including 361-58 on the ground.
No. 5 Ohio State 45, Maryland 16
Julian Sayin threw four first-half touchdown passes, two to Jeremiah Smith, and the Buckeyes rolled past the Terrapins in Columbus, Ohio.
Sayin passed for 203 yards in the first 30 minutes as the Buckeyes (5-1, 3-0 Big Ten) took a 31-10 halftime lead. Smith's first TD, the 37th of his career, tied Michigan's Anthony Carter for second all-time in the Big Ten. The second one moved Smith one behind record-holder Braylon Edwards of Michigan. Bo Jackson ran for 107 yards and two second-half touchdowns to ice the game.
Maryland used a 52-yard pick-six by Daniel Wingate to pull Maryland (2-4, 0-3) within 31-16 with 5:12 left in the third quarter. Maryland QB Malik Washington completed 12 of 25 passes for 64 yards.
No. 7 Indiana 20, Nebraska 17
Josh Hoover hit Nick Marsh for two long touchdown passes and rallied the Hoosiers to a Big Ten victory over the Cornhuskers in Lincoln, Neb.
Hoover completed 12 of 22 passes for 263 yards and two scores as the Hoosiers (6-0, 3-0) shrugged off their first deficit of the season to extend their winning streak to 22 games heading into next week's home showdown against Ohio State.
Nebraska limited the nation's No. 9 rushing offense to 65 yards -- far below the Hoosiers' 252.6-yard average. Anthony Colandrea, whose 39-yard touchdown keeper gave Nebraska a 17-6 lead with 12:01 to go, finished with 263 passing yards and 47 rushing yards as the Huskers (5-1, 2-1) came up short against a Top 25 foe for the 31st consecutive time.
No. 9 Ole Miss 52, Vanderbilt 17
Trinidad Chambliss threw three touchdown passes and the Rebels scored four touchdowns in a nine-minute span of the second quarter in a rout of the host Commodores in Nashville, Tenn.
Chambliss completed 20 of 30 passes for 213 yards with an interception. He also accounted for a rushing touchdown. Deuce Alexander caught a 39-yard touchdown pass and Shekai Mills-Knight produced a touchdown run of 35 yards for Ole Miss (4-1, 2-1).
Jared Curtis returned from a one-week absence due to a knee injury to pass for 222 yards and a touchdown for Vanderbilt (3-3, 0-3), but he also committed three turnovers, two of which led to touchdowns during the second-quarter blitz.
Kentucky 35, No. 10 LSU 34 (OT)
Kenny Minchey drove the Wildcats to a tying field goal at the end of regulation and ran in the decisive two-point conversion in overtime as they defeated the Tigers in SEC play in Lexington, Ky.
CJ Baxter rushed for 123 yards and two touchdowns, Minchey passed for 246 yards and the Wildcats (5-1, 3-1) won by the same score on a two-point overtime conversion as they did the previous Saturday at South Carolina.
Sam Leavitt passed for 275 yards, two touchdowns and one interception, Jackson Harris caught one of those scoring passes and tossed one of his own for LSU (4-2, 1-2).
No. 12 Utah 41, Kansas 24
Wayshawn Parker ran for 171 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Utes to a victory over the Jayhawks in Salt Lake City.
It marked Parker's second straight game with more than 170 rushing yards after he posted a career-high 174 yards on the ground in Utah's win at Iowa State on Sept. 26. Devon Dampier completed 23 of 30 passes for 238 yards and three touchdowns to help the Utes (5-0, 2-0 Big 12) keep their record unblemished. Dampier added 68 yards and a score on the ground. Ricky Johnson led the Utah receivers with a season-high 104 yards and a touchdown on five catches.
Isaiah Marshall was 19 of 37 for 333 passing yards and two touchdowns to lead Kansas. Cam Pickett, in his third game, tallied a season-high 134 yards on eight catches for the Jayhawks (2-3, 0-2), who outscored the Utes 17-7 in the second quarter to cut the halftime deficit to 21-17 and trailed 27-24 late in the third quarter.
No. 21 UCLA 17, No. 13 Oregon 15
Wayne Knight rushed for a touchdown and caught another while the Bruins' defense stuffed a late two-point conversion attempt to earn a Big Ten win over the Ducks in Eugene, Ore.
UCLA (5-0, 3-0 Big Ten) had not won in Autzen Stadium since 2004, but Knight's 9-yard score off a Ty Dieffenbach pass in the third quarter gave the Bruins a 17-6 lead that proved to be enough of a cushion to snap their eight-game losing streak on Oregon's field. Knight finished with 22 carries for 103 yards and caught three passes for 12 yards.
Oregon (3-2, 1-1) battled back in the fourth quarter after Brock Thomas replaced quarterback Dylan Raiola, who started in place of injured Dante Moore. Thomas hit 11 of 15 passes for 156 yards, which included a 44-yard touchdown strike to Evan Stewart that pulled the Ducks within two with 2:16 to go. After a facemask penalty gave Oregon another chance from the 1-yard line, UCLA's Tyson Ford stuffed Jordon Davison's rush on the subsequent attempt.
No. 14 Missouri 27, Texas A&M 6
Jamal Roberts rushed for 222 yards and two touchdowns, and the Tigers kept the Aggies out of the end zone in the SEC victory at Columbia, Mo. Roberts had 211 rushing yards a week ago against then-No. 8 Florida.
On Saturday, Missouri (5-1, 2-1) intercepted Marcel Reed twice, getting one pick apiece from Trajen Greco and Elijah Dotson. The Tigers allowed 216 total yards, including only 29 on the ground.
Texas A&M (3-3, 1-3), which has lost three of its past four games, trailed 10-3 at halftime and played effectively on defense until the second half, when Roberts and the Mizzou running game appeared to grind down the Aggies. Reed finished 19-of-39 passing for 187 yards.
No. 15 Tennessee 24, Arkansas 17
DeSean Bishop's 8-yard touchdown run with 1:57 remaining led the Volunteers past the Razorbacks in Fayetteville, Ark., for Tennessee's first road win against Arkansas since 2001.
Bishop had 19 carries for 138 yards and George MacIntyre was 18-for-29 passing for 247 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in his first start for the Volunteers (5-1, 2-1 SEC) as he replaced injured true freshman Faizon Brandon.
KJ Jackson completed 15 of 27 passes for 155 yards with one touchdown for Arkansas (5-1, 2-1). Cam Settles led a balanced Razorback running game with 50 of the team's 133 rushing yards.
South Carolina 38, No. 16 Florida 19
Quarterback LaNorris Sellers fired four touchdown passes and rushed for a score as the Gamecocks broke a three-game losing streak with an upset of the Gators in Gainesville, Fla.
After blowing a 17-point lead in a home overtime loss last week against Kentucky, the Gamecocks (3-3, 1-3 SEC) snapped an eight-game conference losing streak as Sellers went 23 of 35 for 279 yards, with no interceptions. Nyck Harbor had 83 receiving yards and a touchdown on four catches.
The Gators (4-2, 2-2) lost their second straight game as Aaron Philo was 21 of 28 for 227 yards and a touchdown, with one interception. Bailey Stockton had 127 yards and a score on eight receptions. Florida's Jadan Baugh (15 carries, 59 yards) scored his NCAA-best 12th rushing touchdown of the season in the fourth quarter.
No. 18 Oklahoma State 42, UCF 28,
Drew Mestemaker threw for 304 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for a third as the Cowboys pulled away in the fourth quarter for the Big 12 triumph in Stillwater, Okla.
With Oklahoma State (4-1, 2-0) clinging to a 27-21 edge early in the fourth quarter, Evan Jackson returned a deflected backward pass 28 yards for a touchdown to give the Cowboys a 35-21 lead with 10:32 to go. After Oklahoma State stuffed a fourth-and-1 play, Mestemaker hit Wyatt Young for a 5-yard score to break it open.
Keyone Jenkins completed 30 of 42 passes for 265 yards and four touchdowns for UCF (3-3, 1-2). Josh Derry caught 11 passes for 84 yards and one score while Caden Piening added seven receptions for 60 yards and a score.
No. 19 USC 31, Penn State 23
Jayden Maiava passed for 301 yards and three touchdowns as the Trojans handed the Nittany Lions a third straight conference loss with a win in University Park, Pa.
Maiava threw a TD pass to Trent Mosley (nine catches, 111 yards), who had missed the previous three games, and also connected on scoring passes to Tanook Hines and Kayden Dixon-Wyatt. King Miller took care of matters on the ground for the Trojans (6-1, 3-1 Big Ten), rushing for 102 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries.
Rocco Becht threw for 289 yards and a score for Penn State (3-3, 0-3). The Nittany Lions' rushing attack totaled just 68 yards on 31 attempts in front of a whiteout crowd of 114,419.
No. 22 Houston 35, Kansas State 16
Conner Weigman threw for 242 yards and four touchdowns, all to Patrick Overmyer, as the Cougars cruised to a victory over the Wildcats in a Big 12 game in Manhattan, Kan.
Overmyer caught eight passes for 83 yards, including touchdowns of 1, 2, 8 and 2 yards. Makhi Hughes rushed for 78 yards and a score, and Re'Shaun Sanford II added 90 yards on the ground for Houston (5-1, 2-1 Big 12), which led 28-3 early in the third quarter.
For the Wildcats (3-2, 0-2), Avery Johnson completed 16 of 30 passes for 182 yards, two touchdowns and one interception. Garrett Oakley and Jaron Tibbs each caught a touchdown pass.
North Carolina 21, No. 25 Pitt 17
Billy Edwards Jr. threw for two touchdowns as the Tar Heels recorded the upset of the Panthers in an Atlantic Coast Conference game in Pittsburgh, giving second-year coach Bill Belichick his first victory against a ranked team.
Edwards completed 18 of 26 passes for 249 yards and two interceptions. The Tar Heels' (3-2, 1-1 Atlantic Coast Conference) go-ahead touchdown came on Edwards' 75-yard touchdown pass play to Shamar Easter with 12:36 remaining in the game.
La'Vell Wright ran for two touchdowns for Pitt (5-1, 2-1). Holden Geriner was 27-for-44 passing for 219 yards, with two interceptions, in his first start following a season-ending knee injury suffered by Mason Heintschel a week earlier.
--Field Level Media
