items.title: Nico Hischier scores milestone goal, leads Devils past Canucks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Nico Hischier scored twice on the power play, including his 200th career goal, and the New Jersey Devils rallied to beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-1 on Saturday afternoon in Newark, N.J.
items.body:
Nico Hischier scored twice on the power play, including his 200th career goal, and the New Jersey Devils rallied to beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-1 on Saturday afternoon in Newark, N.J.
Jake Allen made 20 saves in his 500th career game to get the win as New Jersey snapped a two-game losing skid.
Jesper Bratt had a goal and an assist, Jesper Boqvist also scored and Jack Hughes had two assists for the Devils, who finished with three goals on the power play to claim their second win of the season. Hischier, who signed a five-year, $58.5 million deal in the offseason, also had an assist.
Linus Karlsson had a goal while Leevi Merilainen and Kevin Lankinen combined to stop 33 shots for the Canucks, who suffered their third consecutive loss.
Paul Cotter, the NHL's Third Star of the Week, was held pointless in his first game with the Canucks against his former team.
The teams traded power-play goals to open the scoring in the first period.
Karlsson gave the Canucks a 1-0 lead with a power play goal on a one-timer after taking a pass from Brock Boeser.
Hischier busted out of an early slump to score his first point of the season and 200th goal to tie it 1-1 with Vancouver forward Jonathan Lekkerimaki off for high-sticking.
The Devils then recorded their first regulation lead of the season by capitalizing on a Canucks miscue in the Vancouver zone. Amadeus Lombardi stole the puck from Canucks defenseman Filip Hronek, then took a shot that generated a rebound which was poked in by forward Boqvist to make it 2-1 at 16:24 of the first period.
Boqvist's goal came against Lankinen, who entered the game after starter Merilainen sustained an equipment malfunction when his skate blade fell out. Merilainen left the game with 5:27 remaining in the first and returned for the start of the second period.
Bratt took advantage of a mad scramble in the Canucks' crease early in the second, scoring on the power play from a sharp angle with a shot that ricocheted off a couple Vancouver players into the net to give the Devils a two-goal lead.
Hischier finished off a tic-tac-toe passing play for his second power play goal with just 10 seconds left in the second to make it 4-1.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Une nouvelle attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad fait douze morts, selon des sources
items.author: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
items.creator: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
items.summary: Une attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad a fait douze morts et des dizaines de blessés samedi, selon trois sources au fait du dossier, tandis que tous les vols ont été déroutés.
items.body:
Une attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad a fait douze morts et des dizaines de blessés samedi, selon trois sources au fait du dossier, tandis que tous les vols ont été déroutés.
Cette attaque n'a pas été revendiquée dans l'immédiat mais elle intervient dans le contexte d'une intensification des frappes de missiles menées par les Houthis du Yémen, alliés de l'Iran, contre l'Arabie saoudite.
L'aéroport de Ryad a déjà été visé à deux reprises la semaine passée par des attaques qui ont fait quatre morts et plusieurs blessés, endommageant également un avion de la compagnie Saudia.
Le bureau des médias du gouvernement saoudien n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat aux demandes de commentaires relatives à celle de samedi, pour laquelle le système d'alerte précoce n'a émis aucun avertissement.
Aucun bilan officiel n'a été fourni.
Les sources, dont deux sont des responsables occidentaux, ont prévenu que le nombre de victimes pourrait encore changer. Les blessés, dont certains sont dans un état grave, ont été transportés à l'hôpital, ont-elles indiqué.
Un témoin présent à l'aéroport a dit avoir vu une explosion puis de nombreuses personnes blessées allongées au sol à l'intérieur de l'aéroport. Plus d'une douzaine d'ambulances ont été vues en train de se diriger à vive allure vers les lieux de l'attaque.
Un voyageur blessé a pour sa part indiqué à Reuters avoir vu un objet traverser le ciel à l'extérieur de l'aéroport avant qu'une partie du plafond, près d'une porte d'embarquement, ne s'effondre.
Le président américain Donald Trump, interrogé par des journalistes à la Maison blanche sur une éventuelle participation des États-Unis à des frappes saoudiennes contre les Houthis, a par la suite déclaré : "C'est possible. Nous allons examiner cette question. Nous venons juste d'apprendre cette récente attaque, nous prendrons donc une décision. Nous agissons très rapidement."
L'ambassade des États-Unis à Ryad a indiqué être "au courant des attaques" et a "vivement recommandé à tous les citoyens américains d'éviter cet aéroport et les zones environnantes".
"INCIDENT GRAVE" Les ambassades du Royaume-Uni et d'Irlande en Arabie saoudite ont de leur côté déclaré sur X qu'elles étaient également informées d'un "incident grave", tandis que celle du Canada a indiqué que des "activités militaires en cours" perturbaient les opérations aéroportuaires.
Selon le site de suivi du trafic aérien Flightradar24, tous les vols à destination de Ryad ont été soit déroutés, soit annulés.
Kuwait Airways a indiqué avoir annulé ses vols à destination et en provenance de la capitale saoudienne, invoquant une fermeture de l'aéroport de Ryad due à la "situation sécuritaire".
Etihad Airways et Qatar Airways avaient auparavant annulé plusieurs vols entre leurs hubs respectifs et Ryad, certaines annulations étant maintenues jusqu'à lundi.
Les assauts houthistes de la semaine passée avaient déjà conduit plusieurs compagnies aériennes à suspendre ou à annuler leurs liaisons vers la capitale saoudienne, peu avant la tenue à Ryad d'importantes conférences consacrées à l'énergie et à l'investissement.
Les organisateurs de ces conférences ont indiqué samedi qu'elles se dérouleraient comme prévu et tenté de rassurer les participants quant à leur sécurité.
Les Houthis ont déclaré que les compagnies aériennes devaient éviter l'espace aérien saoudien, qu'ils ont qualifié de zone d'opérations militaires après le lancement, plus tôt ce mois-ci, d'une offensive contre le groupe par le gouvernement yéménite soutenu par l'Arabie saoudite.

items.title: Inter rout Parma, De Bruyne double lifts Napoli
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Inter Milan maintained their strong start to the Serie A campaign with a comfortable 3-0 home victory over Parma on Saturday, while two goals from Kevin De Bruyne eased Napoli to a 3-0 home win against Frosinone following the international break.
items.body:
Inter Milan maintained their strong start to the Serie A campaign with a comfortable 3-0 home victory over Parma on Saturday, while two goals from Kevin De Bruyne eased Napoli to a 3-0 home win against Frosinone following the international break.
First-half goals from Petar Sucic, Hakan Calhanoglu, who converted a penalty, and Marcus Thuram put the champions firmly in control inside the opening 31 minutes. The result lifted leaders Inter to 16 points from six matches.
“After a three-week break, we didn’t know how things would go. We’ve worked well during this period, the players have trained well. I’m happy,” Inter head coach Cristian Chivu told DAZN.
The defeat marked a difficult first game in charge for Parma coach Alberto Gilardino, [USN:L6N45L0WD TEXT:"who succeeded"] Carlos Cuesta following his departure in late September.
“I think you always have to be clear-headed at different moments of the game, depending on who you’re playing against and what you’re up against. The overall picture tonight is that Parma started well, but when you are naive, you pay the price,” Gilardino said.
MCTOMINAY RETURNS FOR NAPOLI In Naples, Scott McTominay was named among the substitutes after recovering from a heart problem as Napoli overcame a sluggish start to beat Frosinone.
Napoli were awarded a penalty in the 29th minute and after Rasmus Hojlund's spot kick was saved by Lorenzo Palmisani, the effort was ordered to be retaken as the goalkeeper was ruled to have moved off his line.
Kevin De Bruyne converted the second attempt before Noa Lang doubled Napoli's lead three minutes later.
McTominay made his return just after the hour mark to a standing ovation from the home crowd, although he was unable to influence the contest.
De Bruyne wrapped up the victory late on, finishing from close range for his second goal of the evening.
The win provided a much needed boost to Napoli as they had suffered two defeats and a draw in their previous five matches. They moved to sixth place with 10 points.
"We had to win," De Bruyne told Sky. "It's a very difficult schedule, but we have to move forward and do our best."
Second placed AS Roma and Lazio, who are both on 13 points, will be in action on Sunday. Roma visit Como, while Lazio host Monza.
Surprise package Cagliari, fourth on 12 points, face a tough home test against Juventus on Sunday.

items.title: PSG beat Le Mans 3-1 as Monaco stay top despite draw
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Paris St Germain's Maghnes Akliouche scored his first goal for the club as the champions eased to a 3-1 home victory over Le Mans in Ligue 1 on Saturday, while league leaders AS Monaco were held to a frustrating 2-2 draw by visiting Toulouse.
items.body:
Paris St Germain's Maghnes Akliouche scored his first goal for the club as the champions eased to a 3-1 home victory over Le Mans in Ligue 1 on Saturday, while league leaders AS Monaco were held to a frustrating 2-2 draw by visiting Toulouse.
The game was played in a tense atmosphere as, amid student protests across France, a banner was unfurled at the stadium which read: "Your riot police repress, our youth resists."
Scuffles broke out as police tried to remove the banner and eventually the entire stand was temporarily emptied of spectators.
PSG took the lead with a penalty converted by Lucas Beraldo, but Le Mans levelled in the second half through Louis Mafouta who blasted home for his fourth Ligue 1 goal this season.
Home coach Luis Enrique reacted by making four substitutions at once just before the hour mark and one of those, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, fired them ahead two minutes after coming on as he reacted quickest to a rebound.
Akliouche then ended the game as a contest with the third, his first goal since switching from Monaco at the start of the season.
PSG were awarded a penalty in added time but Desire Doue’s effort was saved by goalkeeper Nicolas Kocik.
The win leaves PSG in fifth on 11 points after six games.
Monaco let a 2-0 first-half lead slip as they were held by Toulouse. They have 14 points and a one-point lead over Lille.
Edan Diop scored their opener and then turned provider for Matthis Abline to net his first Monaco goal since a move from Nantes.
Casper Tengstedt pulled one back for the visitors with a penalty just after the break before teenager Sion Oppong netted his first Toulouse goal to make it 2-2.
Lille briefly moved top as they won 1-0 at home to 10-man Le Havre before being leapfrogged later on by Monaco.
Dilane Bakwa scored the winner in the fifth minute but Lille were run close by Le Havre, who lost Ayumu Seko to a red card for a professional foul just past the hour mark.
Paris FC remain fourth despite a 1-0 loss at Lorient and sit above local rivals PSG on goal difference.
They had more of the ball but Lorient took their chance as Gabin Bernardeau netted after 68 minutes.
Brest scored four first-half goals before eventually running out 5-1 victors over 10-man Angers in a one-sided contest.
Ludovic Ajorque, Lucas Tousart, Kenny Lala, Mama Balde and Pathe Mboup scored for Brest, while Prosper Peter netted a consolation for the visitors, who had Jordan Lefort sent off after 59 minutes.

Oct 10 : Paris St Germain's Maghnes Akliouche scored his first goal for the club as the champions eased to a 3-1 home victory over Le Mans in Ligue 1 on Saturday, while league leaders AS Monaco were held to a frustrating 2-2 draw by visiting Toulouse.
The game was played in a tense atmosphere as, amid student protests across France, a banner was unfurled at the stadium which read: "Your riot police repress, our youth resists."
Scuffles broke out as police tried to remove the banner and eventually the entire stand was temporarily emptied of spectators.
PSG took the lead with a penalty converted by Lucas Beraldo, but Le Mans levelled in the second half through Louis Mafouta who blasted home for his fourth Ligue 1 goal this season.

Home coach Luis Enrique reacted by making four substitutions at once just before the hour mark and one of those, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, fired them ahead two minutes after coming on as he reacted quickest to a rebound.
Akliouche then ended the game as a contest with the third, his first goal since switching from Monaco at the start of the season.
PSG were awarded a penalty in added time but Desire Doue’s effort was saved by goalkeeper Nicolas Kocik.
The win leaves PSG in fifth on 11 points after six games.
Monaco let a 2-0 first-half lead slip as they were held by Toulouse. They have 14 points and a one-point lead over Lille.
Edan Diop scored their opener and then turned provider for Matthis Abline to net his first Monaco goal since a move from Nantes.
Casper Tengstedt pulled one back for the visitors with a penalty just after the break before teenager Sion Oppong netted his first Toulouse goal to make it 2-2.
Lille briefly moved top as they won 1-0 at home to 10-man Le Havre before being leapfrogged later on by Monaco.
Dilane Bakwa scored the winner in the fifth minute but Lille were run close by Le Havre, who lost Ayumu Seko to a red card for a professional foul just past the hour mark.
Paris FC remain fourth despite a 1-0 loss at Lorient and sit above local rivals PSG on goal difference.
They had more of the ball but Lorient took their chance as Gabin Bernardeau netted after 68 minutes.
Brest scored four first-half goals before eventually running out 5-1 victors over 10-man Angers in a one-sided contest.
Ludovic Ajorque, Lucas Tousart, Kenny Lala, Mama Balde and Pathe Mboup scored for Brest, while Prosper Peter netted a consolation for the visitors, who had Jordan Lefort sent off after 59 minutes.

items.title: Un tiroteo masivo deja nueve muertos en Erie, en Estados Unidos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las autoridades confirmaron la muerte de nueve personas en Erie, en el estado de Pensilvania, en Estados Unidos, tras lo que el gobernador Josh Shapiro calificó como un "trágico tiroteo masivo".
items.body:
Las autoridades confirmaron la muerte de nueve personas en Erie, en el estado de Pensilvania, en Estados Unidos, tras lo que el gobernador Josh Shapiro calificó como un "trágico tiroteo masivo".
El incidente tuvo lugar a última hora del viernes y los investigadores determinaron que todas las muertes ocurrieron antes de que los agentes llegaran al lugar de los hechos, según un comunicado del Ayuntamiento de Erie el sábado.
"He hablado con la alcaldesa Devlin y le he ofrecido todo el apoyo de mi gobierno tras el trágico tiroteo masivo ocurrido anoche en Erie, en el que perdieron la vida nueve de nuestros conciudadanos de Pensilvania", escribió Shapiro en una publicación del sábado por la mañana en X, refiriéndose a la alcaldesa Daria Devlin.
El jefe de policía de Erie, Rick Lorah, dijo en un comunicado tras el tiroteo que la escena era una de las más difíciles a las que se había enfrentado durante su gestion.
"La pérdida de vidas humanas es devastadora, y las circunstancias a las que nos enfrentamos son profundamente inquietantes", agregó.
Lorah añadió que las autoridades seguían trabajando para determinar el motivo. El ayuntamiento indicó que estaba prevista una rueda de prensa para el sábado.

items.title: サウジの空港に再び攻撃、12人死亡・300人超負傷　フーシ派が閉鎖表明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Timour Azhari　Enas Alashray

［リヤド　１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Timour Azhari　Enas Alashray

［リヤド　１０日　ロイター］ - サウジアラビアのリヤドにあるキング・ハーリド国際空港が１０日に攻撃を受け、同国当局によると、少なくとも１２人が死亡、３００人以上が負傷した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が攻撃を認めた。同空港が攻撃されるのは今週３回目。サウジへの攻撃は一段と激しさを増している。

サウジ民間航空当局によると、死者はサウジアラビア人４人、バングラデシュ人２人のほか、米国、ヨルダン、パレスチナ、シリア、スーダン、エジプトの出身者各１人。負傷者は最新の集計で３０９人まで増えた。事情を知る関係者によると、負傷者は救急車やヘリコプターで搬送され、病院は対応に追われた。一部は重体という。

今回の攻撃は事前の警告なく発生し、早期警戒システムの警報も出ていなかった。同空港は今週既に２度攻撃を受け、４人が死亡したほか、駐機中のサウジの民間旅客機が大きく損傷した。相次ぐ攻撃で多数の死者が出たことで、サウジの防衛能力の脆弱性が浮き彫りとなった。

フーシ派の広報部門トップは攻撃後にＸへ投稿し、「リヤド国際空港を閉鎖した」と表明した。フーシ派は、サウジの支援を受けるイエメン政府が５日にフーシ派への攻勢を開始したことを受け、サウジ領空を軍事作戦区域に指定し、民間航空機に同領空を避けるよう警告している。

サウジ主導のアラブ諸国連合軍は今回の攻撃に報復すると表明した。

２０１５年にイエメン内戦に介入したサウジは、フーシ派と地上戦を展開するイエメン政府を支援するため、フーシ派への空爆を続けている。サウジとイエメン政府は、フーシ派支配地域の標的に数百回の攻撃を行ったとしている。フーシ派は、これらの攻撃で女性や子どもを含む民間人が死亡したとしている。ロイターは双方の主張を独自に確認できていない。

今回の攻撃後、トランプ米大統領はホワイトハウスの外で記者団の取材に応じた。米国がサウジによるフーシ派への攻撃に加わる計画があるかと問われ、「そうするかもしれない。検討する。今回の攻撃について知ったばかりだ。決定を下すことになる。われわれは非常に迅速に動く」と述べた。

ルビオ米国務長官は攻撃を非難し、「罪のない民間人の命をあからさまに軽視する行為だ」と述べた。

在リヤド米大使館は「攻撃を把握している」とし、「全ての米国民に対し、同空港と周辺地域を避けるよう強く勧告する」と表明した。在サウジの英国大使館とアイルランド大使館もＸへの投稿で、同空港での「重大な事案」を把握していると明らかにした。カナダ大使館は「進行中の軍事活動」が空港の運営に影響を及ぼしていると説明した。

空港にいた目撃者によると、爆発が起き、その後、屋内で複数の人が負傷して倒れていた。負傷した旅行者はロイターに対し、空港の外で何かが上空を飛んでいくのを見た後、出発ゲート付近の天井の一部が崩落したと語った。

＜リヤドで大型国際会議＞

サウジ民間航空当局によると、リヤドに向かう全便が目的地を変更し、空港の業務は一時停止した。

航空機追跡サイト「フライトレーダー２４」によると、リヤド行きの全便が目的地変更か欠航となった。エティハド航空とカタール航空は、それぞれの拠点空港とリヤドを結ぶ複数の便を欠航にした。一部の欠航は１２日まで続く。クウェート航空も、リヤド空港が「治安情勢」を理由に閉鎖されたとして、リヤド発着便を欠航にしたと発表した。

リヤドでは今月、世界石油会議（ＷＰＣ）とサウジアラビアの政府系ファンド、パブリック・インベストメント・ファンド（ＰＩＦ）が主導する国際金融会議 「未来投資イニシアチブ（ＦＩＩ）」が開かれる。両会議の主催者は１０日、予定通り開催すると表明し、参加者の安全への懸念払拭に努めた

items.title: Bruins score 3 goals in final period, keep Flyers winless
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Capping a three-point effort, Fraser Minten's second goal of the season concluded a three-goal third period for the Boston Bruins in a 5-1 win over the visiting Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday afternoon.
items.body:
Capping a three-point effort, Fraser Minten's second goal of the season concluded a three-goal third period for the Boston Bruins in a 5-1 win over the visiting Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday afternoon.
Pavel Zacha and Mason Lohrei scored to give Boston leads after the first two periods before the emphatic finish. Marat Khusnutdinov and Casey Mittelstadt also lit the lamp, while Minten and JJ Peterka each had two assists.
Jeremy Swayman made 14 saves en route to the Bruins' second straight win and fourth through their first six games.
Boston finished with a 32-15 shots on goal advantage.
Porter Martone scored a power-play goal and Dan Vladar (27 saves) took the loss for Philadelphia, which remains winless at 0-4-2 on the season. The Flyers were missing forward Travis Konecny (lower-body) and defenseman Cam York (upper-body) due to day-to-day injuries.
Zacha's first goal of the season at the 12:24 mark punctuated a dominant opening period in which Boston held a 12-3 edge in shots, including holding Philadelphia without a chance during its first power play.
Less than one minute after the Bruins completed a solid kill, David Pastrnak moved into the zone off a turnover at the blue line and dropped a backhand pass for Zacha, whose shot from the high slot leaked through Vladar and dribbled over the goal line for the opening tally.
The visitors went without a shot for more than half of the second period, but Swayman stood up to the task of Martone's driving backhander with 9:51 to go.
Lohrei doubled Boston's lead with 2:48 left in the middle frame. After Swayman's save on a David Jiricek point shot created an odd-man rush, Minten started the play and Peterka fed the trailing defenseman for a top-shelf wrister coming to the top of the circles.
The Bruins needed only 1:55 of third-period time to make it a 3-0 game, as Khusnutdinov slammed home Minten's pass from behind the net following a crisp sequence between the duo and defenseman Will Borgen.
Martone broke the shutout at 6:32, placing a tight-angle wrister from the left circle upstairs on Swayman.
At 9:21, Boston regained its three-goal advantage after Casey Mittelstadt joined Lohrei with his second goal in as many games. After James Hagens had an initial shot saved by Vladar, he made a diagonal pass to Elias Lindholm in the bottom of the right circle, and Mittelstadt buried it in front.
Minten put the exclamation point on the victory with 4:01 to go, speeding past a defender and down the left side to slip a quick shot five-hole on Vladar.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Spurs show fight as United's struggles deepen at Old Trafford
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: While Tottenham Hotspur have plenty to rue amid a difficult opening to the season, manager Roberto De Zerbi saw something at Old Trafford on Saturday that gave him reason to believe his struggling side may finally be turning a corner.
items.body:
While Tottenham Hotspur have plenty to rue amid a difficult opening to the season, manager Roberto De Zerbi saw something at Old Trafford on Saturday that gave him reason to believe his struggling side may finally be turning a corner.
Spurs are 18th and without a victory after six Premier League games following Saturday's 1-1 draw at Manchester United, yet De Zerbi was heartened by the fight his team showed to thoroughly dominate the game and then snatch a stoppage-time equaliser through Dominic Solanke despite being reduced to 10 men.
"I am very happy because I have seen the right spirit and character," De Zerbi told Sky Sports.
Bryan Mbeumo scored against the run of play before Tottenham's Rodrigo Bentancur was sent off for head-butting Luke Shaw, leaving United fans daring to dream of a much-needed victory, only for Solanke's 92nd-minute header to puncture the mood at Old Trafford.
"We suffered in the game. I like the situation we were in with the red card. We need this situation. We have not accepted the defeat. We have to react in all ways we can," De Zerbi said.
Rather than fold, Tottenham fought until Solanke headed the equaliser in stoppage time, giving De Zerbi's side more to celebrate than their hosts despite their lowly league position.
Spurs, who spent more than £300 million ($397 million) in the transfer market during the close season, have failed to win any of their opening six league matches for only the fourth time in the club's history.
Their manager, however, believes there were signs against United that his ideas are beginning to take hold.
"We have to believe in ourselves and this football way," De Zerbi said. "If we believe, improve and play as a team, we will score many goals and win many games. If we don't play as a team, it is impossible."
For United, there was less cause for optimism.
Michael Carrick's side have collected only six points from their first six games, their poorest start to a league campaign since 1986-87, when they had four at the same stage.
United struggled desperately before taking the lead through Mbeumo. But even with a man advantage, they failed to put away a Tottenham team that had started the day bottom of the table.
"We were mixed (in performance)," Carrick said. "We found it tough first half, it was a challenging first half for us and you could see it just wasn't quite there, it wasn't clicking."
The Reds are also winless in the last three league matches when their opponent has had a red card.
Carrick was particularly frustrated at allowing Tottenham back into the game that appeared to be United's for the taking.
"It's a game we should kill off. And we didn't," he said. "Very disappointed to be in a position like that and not come away with the game."
($1 = 0.7558 pounds)

items.title: 茂木外相がルビオ米国務長官と電話会談、ＩＣＣ制裁で「意思疎通を継続」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tamiyuki Kihara

［東京／ワシントン　１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Tamiyuki Kihara

［東京／ワシントン　１０日　ロイター］ - 茂木敏充外相は１０日夜、米国のルビオ国務長官と電話会談し、トランプ米政権が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁措置を科したことについて、緊密に意思疎通を継続することで一致した。茂木氏はこれに先立ち、ＩＣＣの赤根智子所長とも電話で会談した。

日本外務省によると、茂木氏はＩＣＣについてルビオ氏に「これまで表明している日本の立場」（外務省関係者）を改めて伝達。両氏は緊密に意思疎通を継続していくことで一致した。厳しい安全保障環境の中で日米同盟をさらに強固なものにし、幅広く協力を進めていくために引き続き取り組むことも確認した。

このほか、沖縄県で発生した強盗殺人事件で米兵が逮捕されたことについても「事件の発生防止のために実効性のある措置を取るべく、日米間で協議していくこと」を確認した。赤根氏との電話会談では、ＩＣＣを巡る現下の状況などについて意見交換したという。

米国務省は声明で、日米外相が電話会談で、ＩＣＣへの制裁や３０─３１日に米アトランタで開催される２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合などについて意見交換したと発表した。沖縄県で発生した強盗殺人事件については、 「ルビオ氏は沖縄での日本国民の死去に心からの哀悼の意を示すとともに、日本政府と地元当局が捜査を進めるに当たり、連絡を取り合い全面的に協力するという米国の決意を伝えた」とした。

日本や英国など複数の欧州諸国、カナダの外相は９日、トランプ米政権がＩＣＣ本体に制裁措置を科したことを受け、「制裁が実施されれば、ＩＣＣの活動、献身的な職員、その家族に重大な影響を及ぼすことになる」などとする共同声明を発表した。

高市早苗首相も同日夜、米国の制裁が「日本の立場と相容れるものではなく、深く懸念している」と自身のソーシャルメディア「Ｘ」に投稿。「我が国は国際社会における法の支配を一貫して重視し、その役割を担うＩＣＣを支持している」とも改めて表明した。

ノルウェーに本拠地を置くノーベル賞委員会は同日、ＩＣＣで判事を務めたナビ・ピレイ氏にノーベル平和賞を授与すると発表した。これを受け、トランプ米大統領は自身が受賞できなかったことに不満を表明。恥ずべき不名誉な決定でノルウェーに汚点を残したなどと批判していた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：平田紀之）

items.title: El huracán Isaías se cobra cuatro vidas y deja a unos 670.000 personas sin electricidad en EEUU
items.author: Rhea Abraham, Rajveer Pardesi, Marianna Parraga
items.creator: Rhea Abraham, Rajveer Pardesi, Marianna Parraga
items.summary: Cuatro personas fallecieron tras la llegada del huracán Isaías a primera hora del sábado, y unos 670.000 habitantes de Florida, Alabama, Georgia y Misisipi seguían sin suministro eléctrico cuando la tormenta se debilitó hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, según autoridades locales y los servicios de seguimiento del suministro eléctrico en Estados Unidos.
items.body:
Cuatro personas fallecieron tras la llegada del huracán Isaías a primera hora del sábado, y unos 670.000 habitantes de Florida, Alabama, Georgia y Misisipi seguían sin suministro eléctrico cuando la tormenta se debilitó hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, según autoridades locales y los servicios de seguimiento del suministro eléctrico en Estados Unidos.
Dos de las muertes se debieron a la caída de árboles sobre viviendas, según medios de comunicación locales y las autoridades.
Las autoridades de Florida no habían recibido ninguna solicitud de búsqueda y rescate poco después de que la tormenta tocó tierra, lo que indica que el impacto fue limitado, dijo el gobernador Ron DeSantis.
Sin embargo, seguían existiendo condiciones peligrosas y se esperaban marejadas ciclónicas, inundaciones repentinas, vientos destructivos y riesgo de tornados en algunas zonas del sureste de Estados Unidos, según el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (CNH).
Se prevé que la amenaza de tornados continúe el sábado en algunas zonas del Panhandle de Florida, Georgia y las Carolinas, según el NHC.
Otra tormenta en el océano Pacífico, "Rachel", se desplazaba el sábado hacia la costa del norte de Baja California, provocando ráfagas de viento y mareas más altas, lo que dejó a otras 7.000 personas sin electricidad en California.
Isaías, un huracán de categoría 2 cuando tocó tierra en la costa de Florida y el primero de la temporada atlántica de 2026, se espera que genere rachas de viento en el interior antes de debilitarse por debajo de la fuerza de vendaval más tarde el sábado, según el CNH.
Alrededor del 69% de la producción de petróleo y el 57% de la de gas natural en el golfo de México estadounidense seguían paralizados el sábado, lo que supone un ligero descenso con respecto a las cifras del viernes, según la Administración de Minerales Marinos.
Unas 113 plataformas de producción, que representan el 30% del total, seguían evacuadas, según la agencia.

items.title: Nvidia in talks to invest further in Reflection AI or buy it, FT reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Nvidia is in talks to deepen its investment in open-source startup Reflection AI or acquire it, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.
items.body:
Nvidia (NVDA.O) is in talks to deepen its investment in open-source startup Reflection AI or acquire it, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.
Talks are at an early stage and a deal could take several forms, including a so-called acqui-hire arrangement where Nvidia would hire staff and license technology rather than pursue a full acquisition, potentially avoiding a lengthy regulatory review, the newspaper said.
An agreement could be reached in the coming weeks, according to the report, which cited multiple people familiar with the matter, while adding that the discussions could still fall apart.
Reflection declined to comment on the FT report, while Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Nvidia is already a major financial backer and strategic investor in Reflection AI, having invested $800 million in the startup, the FT reported.
Founded in 2024 by former DeepMind researchers Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou, Reflection develops tools that automate software development, a fast-growing use case for AI.
Reflection's chief executive, Laskin, told CNBC in April that the Nvidia-backed startup was raising fresh capital at a pre-money valuation of [USN:FWN4160Z3 TEXT:"$25 billion"].
The company on Monday launched its first open-weight model, [USN:L4N45R19C TEXT:"Beam,"] as it seeks to compete in coding and agentic tasks with lower-cost Chinese models such as DeepSeek and Kimi.

items.title: Report: Sam Fuld declines offer to head Athletics' front office
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Athletics will continue their search for a president of baseball operations after Sam Fuld declined an offer for the position, ESPN reported Saturday.
items.body:
The Athletics will continue their search for a president of baseball operations after Sam Fuld declined an offer for the position, ESPN reported Saturday.
Fuld is the current president of business operations for the Philadelphia Phillies and will reportedly remain in the same job.
Currently playing home games in Sacramento, Calif., the A's are scheduled to move into a stadium currently under construction in Las Vegas for the 2028 season.
The A's fired general manager David Forst in August as the team limped to a 64-98 record. The franchise last had a winning season in 2021 and last made the playoffs in 2020, when the club advanced to the American League Division Series.
According to ESPN, Boston Red Sox assistant general manager Taylor Smith is a top candidate to take over as A's president of baseball operations.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Colts DE Arden Key (hamstring) lands on injured reserve
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Indianapolis Colts placed defensive end Arden Key on injured reserve Saturday with a hamstring injury.
items.body:
The Indianapolis Colts placed defensive end Arden Key on injured reserve Saturday with a hamstring injury.
Key sustained the injury during Indianapolis' 30-13 victory over the Washington Commanders last Sunday in London.
Key, 30, has recorded eight combined tackles, one forced fumble, 0.5 sacks and three quarterback hits in four starts in his first season with Indianapolis (2-2). He signed as a free agent in March.
Key has 200 combined tackles, 31 sacks, 39 tackles for loss, five forced fumbles and two fumble recoveries in 120 regular-season games (50 starts) for the Oakland/Las Vegas Raiders (2018-20), San Francisco 49ers (2021), Jacksonville Jaguars (2022), Tennessee Titans (2023-25) and Colts.
The Raiders selected Key in the third round of the 2018 NFL Draft out of LSU.
Also on Saturday, the Colts elevated wide receiver Nick Westbrook-Ikhine from the practice squad to the active roster. He has appeared in two other games this season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Report: FBI awarding UFC exclusive agreement to train agents
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The FBI intends to award the UFC an exclusive contract to train agents in hand-to-hand combat, according to The Athletic.
items.body:
The FBI intends to award the UFC an exclusive contract to train agents in hand-to-hand combat, according to The Athletic.
The report cites a "Sole Source Justification" document filed on September 30th. The form enables the government to award a contract without reviewing bids from competitors.
"The FBI requires a training program for special agents in defense tactical techniques that focus on integrating mixed martial arts (MMA) skills with specialized defense tactics," the document stated. "The purpose of the training is to enhance physical combat abilities, mental toughness, and tactical awareness, which are crucial for special agents in high-risk situations."
The document proposes a one-year, exclusive contract. The financial amount would be redacted.
The UFC and its CEO and president Dana White have working relationship with the Trump administration. The White House hosted UFC Freedom 250 in June.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rubio pledges US cooperation in Okinawa murder case
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Saturday vowed to cooperate with Japanese authorities investigating allegations that a US Marine murdered a woman in Okinawa, a case that sparked protests and prompted a US military curfew and mandatory training in standards and discipline.
items.body:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Saturday vowed to cooperate with Japanese authorities investigating allegations that a US Marine murdered a woman in Okinawa, a case that sparked [USN:L6N45U0MC TEXT:"protests"] and prompted a US military curfew and mandatory training in standards and discipline.
The top US diplomat spoke with Japanese Foreign Minister Motegi Toshimitsu in a phone call, the US Department of State said in a statement following the death of a local woman in a hotel that has renewed tensions over the US military presence.
"Rubio expressed sincere condolences over the death of a Japanese national in Okinawa, as well as the United States’ determination to communicate and fully cooperate with the Government of Japan and local authorities as they conduct an investigation," the department said.
Devin Jacob Ballard, stationed at Marine Corps Air Station Futenma, was [USN:L1N45Q00F TEXT:"arrested"] on October 4 on suspicion of robbing and murdering Anna Yagi, 39, in a hotel in the capital Naha, according to local police. Ballard has denied the allegations.
US military personnel stationed on Okinawa have been given a month-long [USN:L1N45T08D TEXT:"curfew and banned from drinking"] alcohol while they undergo discipline training following the incident.
Japan hosts the largest overseas contingent of US forces globally, with most of the 18,000 Japan-based Marines stationed on Okinawa.
Rubio and Toshimitsu also discussed US sanctions on the International Criminal Court and the upcoming G20 Foreign Ministers gathering in Atlanta scheduled to begin October 30.

items.title: Barcelona cruise past Getafe, Real Madrid stutter to win over Villarreal
items.author: Ruairidh Barlow
items.creator: Ruairidh Barlow
items.summary: Barcelona extended their perfect LaLiga start with a comfortable 3-0 home win over Getafe on Saturday before Real Madrid overcame Villarreal 1-0 despite having Vinicius Jr sent off.
items.body:
Barcelona extended their perfect LaLiga start with a comfortable 3-0 home win over Getafe on Saturday before Real Madrid overcame Villarreal 1-0 despite having Vinicius Jr sent off.
Barca's victory makes it eight wins for Hansi Flick's side and maintains their five-point lead at the top over Atletico Madrid, who won 2-1 at Alaves with a late Cristian Romero goal.
Real Madrid's narrow win keeps them in third place on 18 points, six points off the pace set by their arch-rivals, but Jose Mourinho is no closer to improving their performances.
The three-week international break did little to disrupt Barcelona’s rhythm and they went ahead after two minutes when Anthony Gordon cut inside and saw his shot deflect off Getafe midfielder Mario Martin and beyond goalkeeper David Soria.
The visitors struggled to escape their own half under sustained pressure and Gabriel Jesus punished a giveaway by Zaid Romero to score on the half-hour in his first start for Barca.
The hosts remained firmly in control after the break, with Getafe testing Joan Garcia only once on the keeper’s return from injury.
Jules Kounde, who missed a clear chance in the first half, completed the scoring for Barca in the 73rd minute with a simple finish from Lamine Yamal’s curling cross.
MBAPPE HITS THE POST Real had the clearer first-half openings against Villarreal, with Kylian Mbappe's seventh-minute shot hitting the post.
They remained unconvincing on the ball, although neither side was able to direct proceedings. Villarreal were equally imprecise with their passes and chances were in short supply.
The tempo increased in the second half and Yan Diomande scored the winner when he beat the offside trap in the 63rd minute and found the bottom corner of the net. It was the Ivory Coast forward's first goal for Real since joining in August.
A forlorn Vinicius Jr watched 19-year-old Diomande in the Brazilian's preferred left-wing position from the bench in the first half but was bright when he came on after 52 minutes to replace wing back Trent Alexander-Arnold.
Eight minutes after the opener, Vinicius thought he had scored Real's second, with Mourinho jogging to the goal-line to celebrate with the substitute.
However, after a VAR review, the goal was chalked off and Vinicius was sent off for pulling substitute Nathan Saliba's hair in the build-up.
An open game ensued, with Villarreal's Peter Gulacsi and Real's Thibaut Courtois making excellent saves. In the closing stages, the frustrated visitors could not stretch their 10-man hosts sufficiently to find gaps in their backline.
The fiery reaction to Vinicius' sending off from Mourinho and his players infused Real's defending with extra intensity, and a positive rearguard effort was rewarded with a clean sheet.
Mourinho did not attend his post-match press conference, with no reason given by the club. The Portuguese now begins preparations for Real's next game at AS Roma in the Champions League as he searches for a consistent pattern of play.
ATLETICO GRAB LATE WINNER Atletico's Alejandro Grimaldo opened the scoring against Alaves after a brilliant interchange with Jonathan David before a Lucas Boye penalty for the hosts in first-half stoppage time.
But Angel Perez was sent off for Alaves in the 61st minute and Atletico's pressure told three minutes from time, with central defender Romero scoring from a deft Alex Baena assist.
Rayo Vallecano's home clash with Athletic Club was [USN:L6N45W02X TEXT:"abandoned due to fan protests"] at Vallecas Stadium.

items.title: Índia detém milhares e tenta barrar protesto contra chefe da comissão eleitoral
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A polícia deteve mais de 2.000 manifestantes e o fundador do movimento juvenil “Cockroach” em Délhi no sábado, enquanto as forças de segurança isolavam partes da capital para impedir uma manifestação que exigia a renúncia do chefe eleitoral da Índia.
items.body:
A polícia deteve mais de 2.000 manifestantes e o fundador do movimento juvenil “Cockroach” em Délhi no sábado, enquanto as forças de segurança isolavam partes da capital para impedir uma manifestação que exigia a renúncia do chefe eleitoral da Índia.
Milhares de policiais e membros de forças paramilitares foram mobilizados por toda a cidade, os serviços de internet móvel foram suspensos no distrito comercial central e dezenas de estações de metrô e mercados foram fechados, enquanto as autoridades agiam para impedir uma manifestação organizada pelo movimento Cockroach.
O protesto tinha como alvo o presidente da Comissão Eleitoral, Gyanesh Kumar, devido a uma revisão das listas eleitorais que, segundo os críticos, beneficia desproporcionalmente o Partido Bharatiya Janata (BJP), do primeiro-ministro Narendra Modi, atualmente no poder.
O movimento havia planejado reunir milhares de pessoas em Jantar Mantar, no centro de Délhi, mas a área foi isolada pelas forças de segurança antes do início da manifestação.
Um funcionário do Ministério do Interior, que falou sob condição de anonimato, disse à Reuters que mais de 2.000 pessoas foram detidas em Délhi. A mídia local informou que cerca de 400 manifestantes foram detidos no centro financeiro da Índia, em Mumbai.
Não houve comentário imediato da polícia sobre as detenções.
Pequenos protestos eclodiram em outros pontos de Délhi, inclusive em um popular mercado de artesanato e no memorial ao líder do movimento pela liberdade, Mahatma Gandhi, com manifestantes exigindo a renúncia de Kumar.
“Viva a revolução”, gritavam alguns jovens manifestantes enquanto a polícia os perseguia e arrastava dezenas de outros para dentro de ônibus para levá-los embora, mesmo com a chegada de mais pessoas, relatou uma testemunha da Reuters.
“Isso está violando os direitos do povo e o país não vai mais tolerar isso”, disse Yogendra Solanki à Reuters enquanto a polícia o escoltava para longe.
A polícia deteve o fundador do partido Cockroach Janta, Abhijeet Dipke, e os líderes seniores Saurav Das e Ashutosh Ranka quando o voo deles, proveniente de Mumbai, pousou em Délhi, informou o grupo em comunicado.
Representantes de dois veículos de notícias digitais afirmaram que a polícia deteve brevemente quatro de seus repórteres enquanto cobriam as manifestações. Um jornalista da Reuters também foi detido por um breve período antes de ser liberado.

items.title: USA-La survivante d'une tentative d'exécution quitte l'hôpital et retourne en prison
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Christa Pike, la condamnée à mort dont l'exécution a échoué la semaine dernière dans le Tennessee, est sortie samedi de l'hôpital pour être renvoyée en prison où elle continuera de recevoir des soins médicaux, ont indiqué ses avocats.
items.body:
Christa Pike, la condamnée à mort dont l'exécution a échoué la semaine dernière dans le Tennessee, est sortie samedi de l'hôpital pour être renvoyée en prison où elle continuera de recevoir des soins médicaux, ont indiqué ses avocats.
Christa Pike a regagné le centre Debra K. Johnson où elle est incarcérée depuis plus de 30 ans, ont-ils précisé dans un communiqué.
Condamnée à mort pour un meurtre commis en 1995, Christa Pike s'est réveillée "en colère et désorientée" à l'hôpital cette semaine avec une longue convalescence devant elle après avoir survécu à la tentative d'exécution du 30 septembre, avaient indiqué ses avocats mercredi, alors qu'ils estimaient auparavant qu'elle pouvait être en état de mort cérébrale.
Christa Pike, âgée de 50 ans, avait été transférée de la chambre d'exécution vers un hôpital de Nashville, inconsciente, dans un état critique et présentant de graves blessures aux bras, après l'échec de deux injections létales à la prison de haute sécurité de Riverbend.
Un juge du Tennessee a ordonné cette semaine aux autorités de l'État de conserver toutes les preuves liées à cette tentative d'exécution ratée, une décision que l'un des avocats de la condamnée à mort a qualifiée de "première d'une longue série de mesures visant à préserver et à faire respecter ses droits constitutionnels".
Le gouverneur du Tennessee a suspendu toutes les exécutions jusqu'à la fin de l'année, le temps que les enquêteurs se penchent sur l'exécution ratée de Christa Pike et sur un échec similaire datant du mois de mai.

items.title: Jessica Korda welcomes baby girl: 'No longer outnumbered'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Jessica Korda is proud to be a "girl mom."
items.body:
Jessica Korda is proud to be a "girl mom."
The LPGA golfer and husband Johnny DelPrete recently announced the birth of their second child, Olivia Regina DelPrete. The middle name carries a special family significance as it honors Jessica's mother, Regina Korda, a former tennis player and Olympian who represented Czechoslovakia at the 1988 Summer Games in Seoul.
"Mom is no longer outnumbered," Korda wrote in her Instagram post.
Olivia joins Korda's first child, Greyson John DelPrete, who was born in February 2024.
"AND IM A GIRL AUNTIE," Nelly Korda wrote in the comments on Jessica's post. "SHES A GIRL MOM"
Jessica Korda, 33, has won six times on the LPGA Tour. Her most recent victory was at the Diamond Resorts Tournament of Champions in January 2021.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Sobrevivente de execução no Tennessee recebe alta do hospital e volta para prisão
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A condenada à morte Christa Pike recebeu alta de um hospital nos EUA neste sábado e foi levada de volta à prisão, onde continuará recebendo cuidados médicos após a tentativa fracassada de execução no Tennessee, informaram seus advogados.
items.body:
A condenada à morte Christa Pike recebeu alta de um hospital nos EUA neste sábado e foi levada de volta à prisão, onde continuará recebendo cuidados médicos após a tentativa fracassada de execução no Tennessee, informaram seus advogados.
Pike recebeu alta de um hospital local e agora se encontra no Centro de Reabilitação Debra K. Johnson, onde está há mais de 30 anos, afirmaram os advogados Stephen Ferrell e Luke Ihnen, do Serviço de Defensoria Federal do Leste do Tennessee, e Randy Spivey e Kelly Gleason, do Escritório de Defensoria Pós-Condenação do Tennessee, em um comunicado conjunto.
Pike, condenada à morte por um homicídio ocorrido em 1995, acordou “irritada e confusa” no hospital nesta semana, com um longo processo de recuperação pela frente após ter sobrevivido à tentativa de execução em 30 de setembro, informaram seus advogados na quarta-feira. Anteriormente, eles acreditavam que ela pudesse estar em morte cerebral.
Pike, de 50 anos, havia sido levada da câmara de execução para um hospital em Nashville, inconsciente, em estado crítico e com ferimentos graves nos braços, depois que duas injeções não conseguiram matá-la na Instituição de Segurança Máxima de Riverbend.
Um juiz do Tennessee ordenou nesta semana que as autoridades estaduais preservassem todas as provas relacionadas à tentativa fracassada de executá-la, um desdobramento que um de seus advogados chamou de “o primeiro de muitos passos para preservar e fazer valer seus direitos constitucionais”.
O governador do Tennessee, Bill Lee, suspendeu todas as execuções pelo resto do ano enquanto investigadores analisam a execução mal sucedida de Pike e um caso semelhante envolvendo Tony Carruthers em maio, quando os agentes penitenciários não conseguiram instalar as linhas intravenosas.

items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, pidió este sábado un nuevo liderazgo en Ucrania y arremetió contra el presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski, a quien instó a dejar de atacar las refinerías de petróleo rusas.
"Más le vale que pare de una vez", dijo Trump a periodistas en la Casa Blanca, un día después de anunciar que había llegado a un acuerdo que permitía a Rusia suministrar diésel a los mercados mundiales.
"Les sugiero que busquen un nuevo líder capaz de llegar a un acuerdo", dijo, refiriéndose a Zelenski.

items.title: Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike released from hospital, returned to prison
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Governor Bill Lee has suspended all executions for the rest of the year.
items.body:
Death row inmate Christa Pike was released from a US hospital on Saturday and sent back to prison where she will continue receiving medical care following her [USN:L1N45M031 TEXT:"botched execution attempt in Tennessee"], her attorneys said.
Pike was discharged from a local hospital and is now at the Debra K. Johnson Rehabilitation Center, where she has been housed for more than 30 years, said attorneys Stephen Ferrell and Luke Ihnen from Federal Defender Services of Eastern Tennessee, and Randy Spivey and Kelly Gleason from the Tennessee Office of the Post Conviction Defender in a joint release.
Pike, sentenced to death for a 1995 murder, awoke "angry and confused" in the hospital this week with a long recuperation ahead after surviving the attempted execution on September 30, her lawyers said on Wednesday. They previously believed she could be brain-dead.
Pike, 50, had been taken from the execution chamber to a Nashville hospital, unconscious, critically ill and with severe arm injuries after two injections failed to kill her at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution.
A Tennessee judge this week [USN:L1N45T0M9 TEXT:"ordered"] state officials to preserve all evidence related to their failed attempt to execute her, a development one of [USN:L1N45T0M9 TEXT:"her lawyers"] called the "first of many steps to preserve and enforce her constitutional rights."
Tennessee Governor Bill Lee suspended all executions for the rest of the year while investigators look in to the botched execution of Pike and a similar failure involving Tony Carruthers in May, when prison officials were unable to set up intravenous lines.

items.title: Man United fans revive ticker taunt over Man City financial case
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: Manchester United fans revived one of English football's most famous banners on Saturday to taunt Manchester City amid their rival's battle with the Premier League over more than 100 alleged breaches of financial rules.
items.body:
Manchester United fans revived one of English football's most famous banners on Saturday to taunt Manchester City amid their rival's battle with the Premier League over more than 100 alleged [USN:L6N45L10G TEXT:"breaches"] of financial rules.
A banner bearing the words "51 YEARS" was unfurled in the Stretford End during United's Premier League game against Tottenham Hotspur on Saturday.
By displaying the figure, United supporters sought to suggest that any trophies won by City between 2009 and 2018 -- which form the core of the Premier League's case against the club -- should not count, effectively extending their wait for silverware back to their 1976 League Cup success.
The banner echoed the "24 YEARS" sign first displayed by United fans in 2000, highlighting City's then two-decade-plus trophy drought.
The number was increased annually as City endured a barren spell and eventually reached 35. The banner disappeared after City lifted the FA Cup in 2011, their first major trophy since 1976, before they went on to win multiple Premier League titles, domestic cups and the Champions League.
City were charged by the Premier League in February 2023 with more than 100 alleged breaches of financial regulations covering a period from 2009 to 2018.
[USN:L8N45V0N7 TEXT:"Enzo Maresca's"] team travel to Liverpool on Sunday in their first game since being found guilty of serious breaches of the league's financial rules. City have denied wrongdoing and lodged an appeal against the independent commission's verdict.

items.title: Russian attack on Ukrainian city kills 20, a day after Trump eases diesel sanctions on Moscow
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Twenty people, including three children, die as Russian glide bombs hit Zaporizhzhia flats, the third mass-casualty strike on Ukraine this week.
items.body:

Russian attack on Ukrainian city kills 20, a day after Trump eases diesel sanctions on Moscow

Twenty people, including three children, die as Russian glide bombs hit Zaporizhzhia flats, the third mass-casualty strike on Ukraine this week.

ZAPORIZHZHIA, Ukraine: Twenty people, including three children, were killed in a Russian attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia on Satur day (Oct 10) , a day after US President Donald Trump announced a deal to lift sanctions on Russian diesel in a major setback for Kyiv .
"To day , Russia said thank you for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia," Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, in some of his sharpest criticism yet of the White House.
Zaporizhzhia has been a regular target of Russian bombardment with strikes intensifying in the past few months.
A 6-year-old girl was among those killed when one strike reduced part of an apartment block to rubble. Her grandfather, Anatoliy Chumniy, stood sobbing over her body, laid on the ground in a white bag, after rescuers pulled it from the wreckage.

"Her birth day would have been at the end of the month," he said through tears.
Eighteen others were wounded in the attack on the industrial city , with a pre-war population of over 700,000 and whose outskirts lie less than 30 km (20 miles) from the front line.

Rescuers evacuate wounded residents, Yana and her husband Anton, found under debris of an apartment building damaged during a Russian air strike, amid Russia's attack on Ukraine, in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine October 10, 2026. REUTERS/Stringer

A woman reacts after pulling her relatives from the rubble of a residential building destroyed by a Russian airstrike in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026. (AP Photo/Kateryna Klochko)

RUSSIA ESCALATING ATTACK S ON UKRAINIAN CITIES It was the third mass-casualty attack on Ukraine this week.
Nearly 80 civilians were killed in Russian strikes on Wednes day and Thurs day , including at least 30 killed by a bomb in the eastern garrison city of Kramatorsk and 22 others by a missile in the town of Pryluky, 80 miles east of Kyiv.
A senior official in Zaporizhzhia, Mykhailo Semikin, said Russia had hit several locations simultaneously in the early hours of Satur day .
Rescuers clambered through crumbled masonry to pull other residents of the building out alive. One man, whose leg was trapped in the rubble, screamed in pain as he was being freed.
"If (the Russian s) have money, they’ll be able to carry on fighting us," said Nataliia Malysheva, a 49-year-old local resident whose parents died in hospital after being pulled from the rubble.
"How many lives have been lost here, how many homes have been destroyed? How many innocent people have died in the meantime?"

Related:

Russian strike on buses kills 30 in frontline Ukrainian city

MOSCOW NEEDS 'DIFFERENT SIGNALS' "Last night provided yet more confirmation that Russia perceives any easing of pressure as a signal that it can supposedly keep fighting, that it can supposedly keep dropping bombs on cities. Different signals are needed," Zelenskyy said.
A missile attack on Satur day after noon also hit a restaurant, wounding seven people in Kyiv.
Russian drones flew over Kyiv throughout the day , part of a vast new wave of bombardment of the capital, the heaviest since the early day s of the war.
Russia’s Defence Ministry said on Satur day its drones had struck a data-processing centre in Kyiv and a cargo ship carrying military supplies to the Ukrainian port of Odesa.

Read more:

Commentary: Russia’s new jet‑powered drones mark latest evolution in air war above Ukraine

TRUMP LIFTS DIESEL SANCTIONS Trump 's decision to lift sanctions on Russian diesel exports comes as his administration seeks to curb fuel prices, which have risen sharply during the US conflict with Iran.
Kyiv had instead urged Washington to increase pressure on Moscow in an effort to force it into serious negotiations to end the four-and-a-half-year war.
Trump , meanwhile, has criticised Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries, which he claims have driven up global prices. Kyiv has said it wants a total halt on all energy strikes by both sides as Moscow pummels Ukraine's power grid.
On Satur day , parts of Kyiv and the surrounding region were left without power, bringing the city 's metro trains to a complete halt for the second time this week.
The latest strikes came after Ukrainian and European officials held talks with US negotiators in Miami on Fri day aimed at developing a common proposal for ending the war, according to a person familiar with the discussions.

Related:

Trump says Putin agrees to major release of diesel to US, global markets

Trump announced the diesel deal while the negotiations were underway, a move Zelenskiy said had caught Kyiv by surprise.
The Ukrainian delegation was headed home on Satur day , presidential aide Dmytro Lytvyn was cited by the Interfax Ukraine news agency as saying.
Russian President Vladimir Putin said after a call with Trump that an immediate resumption of peace talks was unlikely, citing Ukrainian drone attack s on Moscow .
US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner may visit Moscow within the next two weeks, Russian state news agency TASS reported on Satur day , citing a source.
Four civilians were killed and five others were wounded as a result of Ukrainian attack s on the Russian -controlled Luhansk region in eastern Ukraine, the Russian -installed governor said on Satur day .
Reuters could not independently verify the report and there was no immediate comment from Ukraine.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: Erie, Pennsylvania shooter killed 8 people, then himself, police say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A 45-year-old man shot and killed eight people, including a pregnant woman and two children, then apparently shot himself to death, authorities said.
items.body:
A 45-year-old man shot and killed eight people in Erie, Pennsylvania, including a pregnant woman and two children, then apparently shot himself to death, authorities said on Saturday at a press conference where they revealed details of the previous evening's shooting.
The shooter, who has yet to be identified, died of an apparent self-inflicted wound before officers arrived on the scene, said Erie Police Chief Rick Lorah.
"Some scenes stay with you long after you leave them. This is one of those tragic scenes," Lorah said.
Police have yet to establish a motive, Lorah said. He said eight of the nine who died in the shooting were family members, and one was a family friend.
Lorah said after the shooter entered the home, he came out of the house and shot two women who appeared "distressed" and were pacing back and forth seeking assistance from neighbors.
Police found the suspect on the second floor of the home on Perry Street, Lorah said.
Erie Mayor Daria Devlin said the police department "arrived at a horrific scene, faced unimaginable circumstances, and carried out their duties with courage and professionalism."
"They too are members of this community, and they too will carry the weight of what happened last night," she said.
Earlier, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro said in a statement on X that he had spoken with Mayor Devlin and had offered support following "the tragic mass shooting."
Shapiro has long advocated for "common sense gun safety," and pushed the Pennsylvania General Assembly in 2024 to pass gun reforms, including universal background checks and restrictions on ghost guns, which are homemade guns that lack serial numbers and cannot be traced. Several of Shapiro’s proposals have stalled in the state legislature.
There have been more than 400 mass shootings in the US in 2026, according to data compiled by Gun Violence Archive, which defines a mass shooting as one in which four or more people are shot, excluding the shooter. The last recorded mass shootings in Pennsylvania took place in July in Philadelphia, according to the data.

items.body:
Nove pessoas foram confirmadas como mortas em Erie, no Estado norte-americano da Pensilvânia, segundo autoridades, após o que o governador Josh Shapiro chamou de “trágico tiroteio em massa”.
O incidente ocorreu na noite de sexta-feira e os investigadores determinaram que todas as mortes ocorreram antes da chegada dos policiais ao local, segundo comunicado divulgado pela prefeitura de Erie no sábado.
“Conversei com o prefeito Devlin e ofereci todo o apoio do meu governo após o trágico tiroteio em massa ocorrido ontem à noite em Erie — que matou nove de nossos concidadãos da Pensilvânia”, escreveu Shapiro em uma postagem na manhã de sábado no X.

items.body:
Alabama tight end Josh Ford is expected to play on Saturday against No. 2 Georgia in Tuscaloosa, ESPN reported.
Ford underwent surgery this week to repair a broken arm, an injury sustained last Saturday in the sixth-ranked Crimson Tide's 56-23 victory over Mississippi State.
A transfer from Oklahoma State, Ford reeled in his lone catch of the season for a touchdown reception in Alabama's 49-18 victory over South Carolina on Sept. 26.
He is known more as a blocking tight end for the Crimson Tide (5-0, 3-0 Southeastern Conference).

items.title: El huracán Simón se intensifica hasta alcanzar la categoría 4 frente a las costas de México
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El huracán Simón se intensificó el sábado hasta convertirse en una potente tormenta de categoría 4 frente a la costa del Pacífico de México, lo que supone una amenaza de vientos destructivos, marejadas ciclónicas e inundaciones potencialmente mortales a medida que se aproxima a tierra.
items.body:
El huracán Simón se intensificó el sábado hasta convertirse en una potente tormenta de categoría 4 frente a la costa del Pacífico de México, lo que supone una amenaza de vientos destructivos, marejadas ciclónicas e inundaciones potencialmente mortales a medida que se aproxima a tierra.
El Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos (CNH) indicó que el sábado por la mañana Simón se encontraba a unos 185 kilómetros al sur-suroeste de Manzanillo, con vientos máximos sostenidos de 240 kilómetros por hora mientras se desplazaba hacia el norte.
Se prevé que Simón se acerque a la costa centro-occidental de México como un huracán de gran intensidad a última hora del sábado o a primera hora del domingo, y aún es posible que se intensifique más antes de tocar tierra, según el NHC.
Se emitió una advertencia de huracán para algunas zonas de la costa pacífica de México al sur de la localidad turística de Puerto Vallarta, incluida la zona en torno a Manzanillo, el mayor puerto mexicano del Pacífico. Más al sur, hacia Lázaro Cárdenas, estaba en vigor una alerta de tormenta tropical.
El CNH instó a los residentes de la zona de alerta, que también incluye el archipiélago de las Islas Marías, situado frente a la costa, a acelerar los preparativos para proteger vidas y bienes.
"Simón se ha intensificado con una rapidez increíble, y eso es lo que hace que tormentas como esta sean tan peligrosas", dijo el meteorólogo de AccuWeather, Dan Pydynowski.
"Los fuertes vientos podrían causar daños en viviendas y negocios, mientras que las inundaciones y los deslizamientos de tierra podrían arrasar las carreteras y dificultar el acceso de los equipos de emergencia a algunas comunidades. Incluso después de que pase la tormenta, los cortes de electricidad y los daños en las infraestructuras podrían complicar la recuperación".
Las autoridades mexicanas advirtieron de que se esperaban fuertes lluvias en los estados de Guerrero, Michoacán, Colima y Jalisco.
El NHC indicó que se espera que Simón provoque entre 25 a 51 centímetros de lluvia en algunas zonas del suroeste de México hasta el domingo, con precipitaciones aisladas de hasta 76 centímetros en algunas partes de Michoacán, Colima y Jalisco. Las lluvias podrían provocar inundaciones y deslizamientos de tierra que pongan en peligro la vida, especialmente en zonas montañosas.

items.author: Reuters

items.summary: Infosys , India's second-largest IT firm, said on Saturday that it does not anticipate a material impact from the Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) application suspension announced by the US government.
items.body:
Infosys (INFY.NS) , India's second-largest IT firm, said on Saturday that it does not anticipate a material impact from the Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) application suspension announced by the US government.
The US government said on Thursday it was [USN:L4N45U1DA TEXT:"suspending"] some major global tech and IT firms, including Infosys, from the PERM green card program, which allows skilled foreign workers to gain permanent residency in the US through their employment.
"We welcome the opportunity to work with the Department of Labor and related government agencies to answer any questions they may have," Infosys said in an exchange filing.

items.title: Rangers G Igor Shesterkin out for season with lower-body injury
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New York Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin will miss the remainder of the season due to a lower-body injury, the team announced Saturday.
items.body:
New York Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin will miss the remainder of the season due to a lower-body injury, the team announced Saturday.
The news comes one day after the 2021-22 Vezina Trophy winner sustained the injury during the second period of a 3-1 loss against the host Washington Capitals.
Also on Saturday, the Rangers announced goaltender Joonas Korpisalo will be sidelined for the next four weeks due to a lower-body injury.
Shesterkin appeared to awkwardly jam his right skate into the goalpost while sliding into position to make a save.
After stopping 13 of the 14 shots he saw, Shesterkin remained down on the ice for several minutes and had to be helped to the bench by a pair of teammates without putting any pressure on his right leg. Dylan Garand, who made 22 saves in New York's 2-0 win at Detroit on Oct. 2, replaced Shesterkin.
"It's awful," Rangers captain J.T. Miller said after the game Friday. "He's a pillar of this team. It stinks. Obviously, it's (early). We don't even know what's going on, but to see him leave the game is a shot to all of us, a shock to all of us. But at the same time, it means we got to step up to a man to try to get the job done, especially (Garand)."
Shesterkin finishes his season with a 3-1-0 record, a 1.79 goals-against average and a .927 save percentage in five games (all starts). He is in the second season of an eight-year, $92 million contract.
Shesterkin, 30, is 190-108-28 with a 2.51 GAA and .917 save percentage in 330 career games (325 starts) with the Rangers.
The Rangers acquired Korpisalo from the Boston Bruins in July for forward prospect Kalle Vaisanen and a fourth-round draft pick in 2028.
Korpisalo, 32, was Boston's No. 2 goaltender last season and went 14-9-6 with a 3.15 goals-against average and .894 save percentage in 29 starts.
In 11 NHL seasons, Korpisalo is 140-126-38 with a 3.06 GAA and eight shutouts since entering the league in 2015. He played 7 1/2 seasons with the Columbus Blue Jackets and also has played for the Los Angeles Kings and Ottawa Senators in addition to spending the last two seasons with Boston.
While with the Blue Jackets, Korpisalo made an NHL postseason record 85 saves during a five-overtime, 3-2 loss to the Tampa Bay Lightning on Aug. 11, 2020.
Korpisalo earned a bronze medal at the 2026 Olympics in Italy while playing for Finland.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Alonso hails Caicedo’s impact as Chelsea crush Bournemouth
items.author: William Schomberg
items.creator: William Schomberg
items.summary: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has had to wait until October to see what his side can do with midfielder Moises Caicedo properly back in the team and he was delighted with his role in the 5-1 demolition of Bournemouth in the Premier League on Saturday.
items.body:
Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has had to wait until October to see what his side can do with midfielder Moises Caicedo properly back in the team and he was delighted with his role in the 5-1 demolition of Bournemouth in the Premier League on Saturday.
Alonso – who oversaw two victories in his first two matches in charge of Chelsea before failing to win any of the next three - gave Caicedo his first start of the season after being sidelined with a calf problem.
The Ecuadorian, 24, provided a stronger shield for Chelsea's defence that has looked shaky since the campaign began and he formed an effective partnership with 36 year-old Jordan Henderson who scored twice.
Alonso stressed the importance of Caicedo's return after a brief appearance in August when he lasted only 14 minutes as a substitute before having to limp off.
"With him we have a better midfield area and when you are better in the middle you have a more complete team and something to build around," the Spaniard told reporters.
"I am so happy that Moi is feeling better because he is going to be a key player for us. We knew that and we have seen (it) today."
In further encouragement for Chelsea fans, right back Marco Palestra - who signed from Atalanta in Italy in the close season but was injured soon after - made his debut as a substitute.
The two goals from Henderson and another two from Joao Pedro – both players who have also been in the medical room – and a Morgan Rogers strike underscored Chelsea’s reputation as one of the Premier League’s entertainers this season.
They added to their tally of early goals as they rushed into a 2-0 lead within 149 seconds and got their third a little more than 30 seconds after the start of the second half.
Cole Palmer celebrated signing a contract extension by providing two assists, adding to the signs that he is getting back to top form.
The only worries for Alonso were Chelsea's failure to keep a clean sheet for a 22nd Premier League game in a row when Bournemouth striker Evanilson briefly gave the visitors hope in the second half, and the absence of captain Reece James.
Alonso said James - who has missed long spells in recent seasons due to hamstring problems - had suffered a knee injury in training on Friday.
Chelsea will face stiffer tests this season than Bournemouth who have not won any of their six games so far under new manager Marco Rose and were missing key players including England midfielder Alex Scott and strikers Eli Kroupi and Justin Kluivert.
Alonso said Chelsea lost control of the game briefly when Bournemouth pulled a goal back through Evanilson to make it 3-1 in the 51st minute, but he took encouragement from the way they finished off the game with two goals in three minutes later on.
"From today we take positives for the future," he said.

items.title: Hurricane Simon strengthens to Category 4 off Mexico coast
items.author: Daniel Becerril, Alberto Fajardo
items.creator: Daniel Becerril, Alberto Fajardo
items.summary: Simon is forecast to be near or just inland of Mexico's west-central Pacific coast on Sunday.
items.body:
Hurricane Simon strengthened into a powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast on Saturday, threatening destructive winds, storm surges and potentially deadly flooding as it approaches landfall.
The US National Hurricane Center said Simon was located about 115 miles (185 km) south-southwest of Manzanillo, Mexico, on Saturday morning, packing maximum sustained winds of 150 mph (240 kph) as it moved northward.
Simon is expected to approach the west-central coast of Mexico as a major hurricane late on Saturday or early Sunday, and some additional strengthening remains possible before landfall, the NHC said.
A hurricane warning was in effect for portions of Mexico's Pacific coast south of the beach resort of Puerto Vallarta, including the area around Manzanillo, Mexico's largest Pacific port. A tropical storm watch was in effect farther south toward Lazaro Cardenas.
The NHC urged residents in the warning area, which also includes the Islas Marias archipelago offshore, to rush preparations to protect life and property.
“Simon has strengthened incredibly quickly, and that’s what makes storms like this so dangerous,” said AccuWeather meteorologist Dan Pydynowski.
“Strong winds could damage homes and businesses, while flooding and mudslides could wash out roads and make it difficult for emergency crews to reach some communities. Even after the storm passes, power outages and damaged infrastructure could make recovery challenging.”
PREPARATIONS UNDER WAY IN MANZANILLO In the early afternoon on Saturday in Manzanillo, residents appeared largely calm despite the approaching storm, with little sign of panic buying at supermarkets, according to a Reuters reporter on the ground. Some stores had begun boarding up their windows, while businesses were closing and streets were relatively empty. Rain had been falling intermittently since late on Friday, and rising seas were pushing waves almost to the entrances of beachfront hotels, although strong winds had yet to arrive.
Civil protection workers had closed beaches, erected barriers and raised red and black warning flags, urging residents to stay away from the shore. Marines, soldiers, National Guard officers and emergency personnel were patrolling areas vulnerable to flooding and landslides, while authorities had begun precautionary evacuations in parts of Cihuatlan, a flood-prone municipality in neighboring Jalisco state, near Manzanillo. Rivers in some areas were already running high, raising concerns they could overflow if heavy rains intensified.
Mexican authorities warned that heavy rainfall was expected in the states of Guerrero, Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco.
UP TO 30 INCHES OF RAIN EXPECTED The NHC said Simon was expected to produce 10 to 20 inches (25 to 51 cm) of rain across portions of southwestern Mexico through Sunday, with isolated totals of up to 30 inches (76 cm) possible in parts of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco. The rainfall could trigger life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in mountainous areas.
A storm surge is expected along the coast near and to the east of where the center makes landfall, accompanied by large and destructive waves, the NHC said. Swells generated by Simon are expected to affect portions of Mexico's southwestern and west-central coast over the coming days, creating dangerous surf and rip current conditions.
Simon is forecast to be near or just inland of Mexico's west-central Pacific coast on Sunday.
Last week, Hurricane Polo made landfall on the Baja California Peninsula as a Category 2 storm, toppling trees and utility poles, flooding streets and causing other property damage.

items.title: Rain washes out qualifying, puts Kyle Larson on pole at Charlotte
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: CONCORD, N.C. -- Persistent rain forced cancellation or postponement of all NASCAR on-track activity on Saturday at Charlotte Motor Speedway.
items.body:
CONCORD, N.C. -- Persistent rain forced cancellation or postponement of all NASCAR on-track activity on Saturday at Charlotte Motor Speedway.
The cancellation of qualifying for the NASCAR Cup Series race puts Kyle Larson on the pole for Sunday's Bank of America 400, the sixth race in the Chase presented by Mobil 1 (3 p.m. ET on USA, PRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio).
In addition, the Blue Cross NC 300 NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series race, scheduled for Saturday afternoon, has been postponed until 8 p.m. ET on Sunday night, following the Bank of America 400. The Blue Cross NC 300 will be broadcast on CW, PRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio.
With the starting order set by a metric formula that combines the results of the previous race with owner points position, Larson, the Chase leader by 40 points over second-place Denny Hamlin, will start beside Chase Briscoe, last Sunday's winner at Las Vegas Motor Speedway.
However, the driver of the No. 5 Hendrick Motorsports Chevrolet doesn't feel the top starting spot will give him as big an advantage as starting on the front row for the third Chase race at Kansas Speedway, where he started second and took control of the race.
"I actually think (Charlotte) is a harder track to maintain a lead, because the grip in the surface is a lot less," Larson said. "At Kansas, you can maintain the lead pretty easily for three quarters of the run, and then they start coming at you.
"From the (Coca-Cola) 600 (at Charlotte in May), I got out to a lead a couple of different times. I guess cars were just faster and passed me with no problem. ... But, yeah, if our car is good, we're going to try our best to get the lead and maintain it."
Christopher Bell, third in the standings and 55 points behind Larson, starts 17th after a power steering failure at Las Vegas. Fourth-place Joey Logano, 71 points back, is seventh on the grid beside fellow Chase driver Bubba Wallace.
Hamlin will take the green flag from the 12th position.
Saturday's qualifying for the O'Reilly Series race also was canceled, leaving Chase driver Carson Kvapil on the pole with Las Vegas winner Corey Day beside him. Defending series champion Jesse Love starts third beside rookie Brent Crews.
Series leader Sheldon Creed is eighth on the grid.
--By Reid Spencer, NASCAR Wire Service

items.title: Motor racing Mercedes' Antonelli says car 'in a better place' but Russell takes 'step backwards'
items.author: Tom Westbrook
items.creator: Tom Westbrook
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli said Mercedes have got to the bottom of the issues on the new upgrade on his car after he qualified fourth-fastest on Saturday in Singapore, but George Russell feels he has taken a "step backwards" after a crash in the sprint.
items.body:
Kimi Antonelli said Mercedes have got to the bottom of the issues on the new upgrade on his car after he qualified fourth-fastest on Saturday in Singapore, but George Russell feels he has taken a "step backwards" after a crash in the sprint.
Formula One championship leader Antonelli, who leads Russell by 89 points, is looking to become the youngest ever world champion at 20 and will line up behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen and the Ferraris of Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton.
Antonelli said he and the team are beginning to come to grips with a new upgrade package that was introduced in Sepang -- where he finished second -- while Russell reverted to an older setup that helped him win in Baku last month.
"It definitely felt in a better place today, even though the window is very small where the car operates," Antonelli said after Saturday's qualifying session.
"The team did a really good job because, first of all, we found the issues. Now we're able to understand more of the package and now it's more about trying to find the right window with the setup to make sure that the package works at its best.
"Let's see what we can do from P4 but a podium will be very good."
'TWO TEST PILOTS' Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff had said on Friday that it had been tricky to assess the upgrade package over consecutive race weekends, with the team running "two test pilots" on the Marina Bay Street Circuit to weigh up the upgrade's value.
"On Kimi's side the updates seem to have worked now," Wolff said.
"He and his engineers have dialled out the problems and we got closer and closer. We're missing a tenth and a half or two-tenths, and that is, at least for qualifying, positive.
"It will take some more proof of concept until I'm feeling warm and fuzzy. But we will have more data tomorrow, in the race, whether we can have less degradation."
Wolff, who on Friday had dismissed suggestions of favouritism within the Mercedes team, said Russell had made a rare mistake to spin out of the lead in the sprint, reminiscent of a last-lap crash at Singapore in 2023 that cost him a shot at victory.
Russell, who was sixth-fastest in Q3 but is set to start at the back of the grid due to an engine penalty, said he used the qualifying session to test whether his car was in working order after retiring from the sprint.
"Something was a bit odd because we had great pace yesterday, and Kimi's in a similar position to where he was yesterday," Russell said.
"But I've taken a step backwards and the car didn't feel quite the same... It'll be tough racing (tomorrow)."
